本批词根亮点：

• -son 家族：resonant（共鸣）/consonant（辅音=共同声音）/dissonant（不和谐）/sonorous（洪亮），全来自拉丁 sonus

• sycophant：原意"告发无花果走私者"，后演变为"拍马屁的人"

• blatant：来自斯宾塞史诗《仙后》中吵闹的怪兽 Blatant Beast，后成形容词"公然嚣张的"

• exorbitant：ex+orbit，"超出轨道的"=过高的，词源形象生动

• recalcitrant：re+calcitrare（用脚后跟踢），一直往后踢=顽固不服从

• abundant：ab+unda（波浪），水浪涌出的=充裕的，inundate（淹没）同根

• recruit：来自 crescere（生长），重新补充生长=招募，crescent（月牙）同根

• jubilant：来自希伯来语"羊角号"（yobel），50年一次吹号庆祝=jubilee（周年庆典）

quiz.question: decrepit ________
quiz.explanation: 破旧的; 衰老的, 破旧的建筑. The decrepit building was scheduled for demolition. 这座破旧的建筑计划拆除。 | de->向下，crep->发出噼啪声（拉丁crepare），decrepit->向下破裂=破旧的（cf. crepuscular黄昏的=光线破碎，decrepitude衰老） || 文化联想：北京老胡同里年久失修、墙皮脱落的老房子最适合帮助记忆 decrepit，可以说 **a decrepit building — “A long-abandoned courtyard house with cracked walls and a sagging roof may become a decrepit building.”**

quiz.question: pulpit ______
quiz.explanation: 讲道坛, 讲道坛布道. The minister delivered a pulpit sermon on forgiveness. 牧师在讲道坛上发表了关于宽恕的布道。 | pulpit->讲台（拉丁pulpitum->台），pulpit->布道台（cf. pulp纸浆，pulpit station布道台） || 文化联想：pulpit 是基督教讲道坛，可用中国教堂里牧师讲道的场景来记忆，可以说 **a church pulpit — “During a Sunday service in a church in China, a pastor may speak from a church pulpit.”**

quiz.question: merit ___
quiz.explanation: 功绩; 优点, 绩效工资. Employees receive merit pay based on performance. 员工根据表现获得绩效工资。 | merit->应得（拉丁merere->赚到），merit->功绩/值得（cf. meritorious有功的，meretricious华而不实，demerit缺点） || 文化联想：中国公司按绩效发奖金最适合帮助记忆 merit，可以说 **merit pay — “A company may use merit pay to reward employees whose performance exceeds expectations.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ writ
quiz.explanation: 令状; 文书, 发出令状. The court will issue a writ of habeas corpus. 法院将发出人身保护令状。 | writ->写下的东西（古英语writan），writ->法律文书（cf. write写，written书面的，Scripture圣经=写下的） || 文化联想：writ 是英美法里的正式令状，可用中国法学生学习人身保护令时来记忆，可以说 **issue a writ — “A Chinese law student may learn that a court can issue a writ such as habeas corpus in common-law systems.”**

quiz.question: posit _ ______
quiz.explanation: 假定; 提出, 提出理论. Scientists posit a theory to explain the phenomenon. 科学家提出理论来解释这一现象。 | posit->放置（拉丁ponere），posit->提出假设（cf. position位置，deposit存款，compose作曲，oppose反对） || 文化联想：中文“先提出一个假设再验证”最适合帮助记忆 posit，可以说 **posit a theory — “A scientist may posit a theory first and then design experiments to test whether it is correct.”**

quiz.question: ____ deposit
quiz.explanation: 存款; 押金, 银行存款. She made a bank deposit of her paycheck. 她将薪水存入了银行存款。 | de->向下，posit->放置，deposit->放到下面=存款/押金（cf. compose作品，impose强加，expose暴露，depose废黜） || 文化联想：中国买房或租房时先交一笔定金或押金的场景最适合帮助记忆 deposit，可以说 **pay a deposit — “A tenant may pay a deposit before moving into a rented apartment.”**

quiz.question: ________ circuit
quiz.explanation: 电路; 巡回, 电路. The electric circuit powers all the lights. 电路为所有灯供电。 | circui->绕圈（拉丁circuire），circuit->绕一圈=电路/巡回（cf. circle圆，circulate循环，circumference周长） || 文化联想：中国中学物理课搭简单电路最适合帮助记忆 circuit，可以说 **an electric circuit — “Students may connect a battery, wires, and a bulb to build a simple electric circuit.”**

quiz.question: _____ conduit
quiz.explanation: 管道; 导管, 水管. The water conduit supplies the entire neighborhood. 水管供应整个社区。 | con->共同，duit->引导（拉丁ducere），conduit->引导流体的管道（cf. conduct传导，duct管道，aqueduct渡槽） || 文化联想：南水北调或城市输水管线的画面最适合帮助记忆 conduit，可以说 **a water conduit — “A large water conduit can carry water from a reservoir toward cities that need additional supply.”**

quiz.question: bruit _____
quiz.explanation: 传播; 散布, 四处传播. Do not bruit about confidential information. 不要四处传播机密信息。 | bruit->噪音/传闻（法语bruit->声音），bruit about->到处散布传闻（cf. brute野兽，bruise淤伤，bruit=rumor传播） || 文化联想：中文“把消息传得满城风雨”最适合帮助记忆 bruit，可以说 **bruit a rumor about — “People who repeat an unverified story everywhere may bruit the rumor about until the whole neighborhood has heard it.”**

quiz.question: recruit ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 招募; 新兵, 招募新成员. The club aims to recruit new members this year. 俱乐部今年旨在招募新成员。 | re->再，cruit->生长（拉丁crescere），recruit->重新补充生长=招募（cf. crescent月牙，accrue积累，increase增加） || 文化联想：中国大学社团开学季招新最适合帮助记忆 recruit，可以说 **recruit new members — “At the start of the semester, a university club may recruit new members with posters and campus events.”**

quiz.question: _____ affidavit
quiz.explanation: 宣誓书, 宣誓的宣誓书. He signed a sworn affidavit before the notary. 他在公证人面前签署了宣誓书。 | affidavit->他发誓了（拉丁，affidar->信任），affidavit->宣誓陈述书（cf. fidelity忠诚，fiancé未婚夫，confide信任） || 文化联想：affidavit 是英美法律中的宣誓陈述，可用中国法学生学习美国诉讼程序时来记忆，可以说 **a sworn affidavit — “A Chinese law student may learn that a witness can submit a sworn affidavit containing facts declared under oath.”**

quiz.question: _____ wit
quiz.explanation: 机智; 才智, 敏锐的机智. Her sharp wit made her a popular speaker. 她敏锐的机智使她成为受欢迎的演讲者。 | wit->知道（古英语witan），wit->机智/才智（cf. witness目击者=知道的人，witty机智的，witticism妙语） || 文化联想：相声演员机灵接梗最适合帮助记忆 wit，可以说 **sharp wit — “A skilled xiangsheng performer may answer a partner instantly with sharp wit that makes the audience laugh.”**

quiz.question: exalt ______
quiz.explanation: 赞扬; 提升, 赞扬美德. Religious texts often exalt virtue and righteousness. 宗教文本经常赞扬美德和正义。 | ex->向上，alt->高（拉丁altus），exalt->举到高处=赞扬/提升（cf. altitude高度，exaltation兴奋，exalted崇高） || 文化联想：中国传统文化常赞扬忠义、诚信等品德，最适合帮助记忆 exalt，可以说 **exalt virtue — “A historical story may exalt virtue by praising loyalty, courage, and integrity.”**

quiz.question: tilt __ _________
quiz.explanation: 倾斜; 攻击, 攻击风车(徒劳的战斗). Do not tilt at windmills like Don Quixote. 不要像堂吉诃德那样攻击风车。 | tilt->倾斜（古英语tealt），tilt at windmills->向风车冲刺=做徒劳的事（堂吉诃德把风车当巨人，cf. tilt倾斜） || 文化联想：《堂吉诃德》译本里“大战风车”的情节最适合帮助记忆 tilt，可以说 **tilt at windmills — “A Chinese student reading Don Quixote may remember that to tilt at windmills is to fight imaginary or hopeless enemies.”**

quiz.question: _________ bolt
quiz.explanation: 螺栓; 闪电, 闪电. A lightning bolt struck the tree during the storm. 暴风雨期间,闪电击中了树。 | bolt->快速飞出（古英语bolt->箭），bolt->螺栓/闪电/逃跑（cf. bolt from the blue晴天霹雳，deadbolt死锁） || 文化联想：中文“晴天霹雳”最适合帮助记忆 bolt，可以说 **a bolt from the blue — “Unexpected bad news can feel like a bolt from the blue—正如中文所说的‘晴天霹雳.’”**

quiz.question: revolt _______
quiz.explanation: 反叛; 起义, 反抗. Citizens began to revolt against the oppressive regime. 公民开始反抗压迫性政权。 | re->回，volt->转（拉丁volvere），revolt->转过身来=反叛（cf. revolve旋转，revolution革命，convoluted复杂） || 文化联想：陈胜吴广起义最适合帮助记忆 revolt，可以说 **revolt against rule — “In traditional historical accounts, Chen Sheng and Wu Guang led a revolt against Qin rule after deciding to resist rather than submit.”**

quiz.question: fault ____
quiz.explanation: 断层; 过错, 断层线. The earthquake occurred along a major fault line. 地震发生在主要断层线上。 | fault->缺陷（拉丁fallere->失败），fault->过错/断层（cf. default默认/违约，default=de+fault，faulty有缺陷的） || 文化联想：四川等地震活跃地区的断层带最适合帮助记忆 fault，可以说 **a fault line — “Earthquake researchers may map a major fault line running through a seismically active region.”**

quiz.question: ____ vault
quiz.explanation: 金库; 跳跃, 银行金库. Valuables are stored in the bank vault. 贵重物品存放在银行金库中。 | vault->拱形（拉丁volvere->卷），vault->拱形屋顶/金库/跳跃（cf. vault过跳，pole vault撑杆跳，the vault of heaven天穹） || 文化联想：中国银行里存放贵重物品的金库最适合帮助记忆 vault，可以说 **a bank vault — “A bank may keep cash, documents, and valuables inside a heavily secured bank vault.”**

quiz.question: occult ________
quiz.explanation: 神秘的; 玄学的, 神秘实践. Some people study occult practice and mysticism. 有些人研究神秘实践和神秘主义。 | oc->覆盖，cult->隐藏（拉丁celare），occult->被隐藏的=神秘的（cf. conceal隐藏，ceiling天花板，occultation掩星） || 文化联想：occult 是西方语境中“神秘学”的词，可用中国学生学习世界宗教与神秘传统时来记忆，可以说 **occult practices — “In a course on Western esoteric traditions, Chinese students may encounter the term occult practices for hidden or mystical rituals.”**

quiz.question: ______ catapult
quiz.explanation: 弹射器; 猛然推进, 发射弹射器. Ancient armies would launch catapult projectiles. 古代军队会发射弹射器抛射物。 | kata->向下，pult->抛（希腊pallein），catapult->向下抛射=弹射器（cf. impel推动，propel推进，repel击退） || 文化联想：中国古代攻城器械中的抛石机最适合帮助记忆 catapult，可以说 **a siege catapult — “An ancient siege army might use a catapult-like machine to hurl stones toward defensive walls.”**

quiz.question: exult __ _______
quiz.explanation: 欢欣鼓舞; 狂喜, 为胜利欢欣鼓舞. The team will exult in victory after the championship. 球队将在赢得冠军后为胜利欢欣鼓舞。 | ex->向外，ult->跳跃（拉丁salire），exult->向外跳跃=欢欣鼓舞（cf. result结果，insult侮辱，exultation狂喜） || 文化联想：中国队夺冠后运动员和观众欢呼雀跃最适合帮助记忆 exult，可以说 **exult in victory — “Players may exult in victory after winning a championship with a last-second score.”**

quiz.question: _____ cant
quiz.explanation: 伪善的话; 行话, 虚伪的伪善话. His pious cant fooled no one. 他虚伪的伪善话骗不了任何人。 | cant->歌唱/吟诵（拉丁cantare），cant->宗教式的吟诵=虚伪的说教（cf. chant吟唱，enchant迷住，incantation咒语） || 文化联想：中文“满口仁义道德、其实空洞虚伪”最适合帮助记忆 cant，可以说 **pious cant — “A corrupt official who constantly lectures others about morality may speak in pious cant that convinces no one.”**

quiz.question: decant ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 倒酒; 倾析, 倒酒. Let the wine breathe, then decant the wine carefully. 让酒透气,然后小心地倒酒。 | de->向下，cant->倾斜/罐（拉丁canthus->罐沿），decant->倾斜倒出=倒酒/倾析（cf. can罐，decanter酒壶） || 文化联想：中国茶席上把泡好的茶从盖碗倒入公道杯最适合帮助记忆 decant，可以说 **decant the tea — “A tea host may decant the tea from a gaiwan into a fairness pitcher before serving the guests.”**

quiz.question: recant _________
quiz.explanation: 撤回; 放弃, 撤回证词. The witness refused to recant testimony under pressure. 证人拒绝在压力下撤回证词。 | re->回，cant->唱/说，recant->收回所说的话=撤回声明（cf. cant伪善话，chant吟唱，enchant迷住） || 文化联想：中文“收回原先的话”最适合帮助记忆 recant，可以说 **recant testimony — “A witness under pressure may be asked to recant testimony that was previously given in court.”**

quiz.question: _______ mendicant
quiz.explanation: 乞丐; 托钵僧, 乞讨的乞丐. The begging mendicant asked for alms on the street. 乞讨的乞丐在街上乞求施舍。 | mendic->乞讨（拉丁mendicus），mendicant->以乞讨为生的人=乞丐/托钵僧（cf. mendicancy乞讨，beg乞求） || 文化联想：中国佛教史里托钵行乞的僧侣形象最适合帮助记忆 mendicant，可以说 **a mendicant monk — “A mendicant monk may live on alms rather than own substantial property or wealth.”**

quiz.question: _____________ significant
quiz.explanation: 重要的; 显著的, 统计上显著的. The results were statistically significant at the 0.05 level. 结果在0.05水平上具有统计显著性。 | sign->标记，fic->制造，significant->制造出标记/含义=显著的（cf. sign标志，signal信号，signify意味） || 文化联想：中国科研论文里“统计显著”最适合帮助记忆 significant，可以说 **statistically significant — “A researcher may report that an experimental difference is statistically significant after completing the analysis.”**

quiz.question: ___ applicant
quiz.explanation: 申请人, 求职者. The job applicant submitted an impressive resume. 求职者提交了一份令人印象深刻的简历。 | apply->申请，cant->做的人（拉丁），applicant->申请的人（cf. apply申请，application申请，applicable适用的） || 文化联想：中国求职者投简历面试最适合帮助记忆 applicant，可以说 **a job applicant — “A job applicant may submit a résumé and complete several interviews before receiving an offer.”**

quiz.question: ______ supplicant
quiz.explanation: 恳求者; 哀求者, 谦卑的恳求者. The humble supplicant begged for mercy. 谦卑的恳求者乞求怜悯。 | sup->向下，plic->折叠/弯曲（拉丁），supplicant->弯下膝盖的人=恳求者（cf. suppliant同义，supplicate跪求，supplant取代） || 文化联想：古装剧里跪地求饶的人最适合帮助记忆 supplicant，可以说 **a humble supplicant — “A character who kneels before a ruler and begs for mercy appears as a humble supplicant.”**

quiz.question: ______ lubricant
quiz.explanation: 润滑剂, 发动机润滑剂. Regular engine lubricant changes extend vehicle life. 定期更换发动机润滑剂可延长车辆寿命。 | lubric->滑（拉丁lubricus），lubricant->使滑动的物质=润滑剂（cf. lubricate润滑，lubricious好色的=滑腻的） || 文化联想：中国汽车保养定期更换机油最适合帮助记忆 lubricant，可以说 **engine lubricant — “A mechanic may replace engine lubricant regularly to reduce friction and wear inside the engine.”**

quiz.question: scant ________
quiz.explanation: 不足的; 缺乏的, 缺乏的证据. There was scant evidence to support the claim. 几乎没有证据支持这一说法。 | scant->短缺（古挪威skamt->短），scant->不足的/吝啬（cf. scanty短缺的，skimp吝啬，scarcely几乎不） || 文化联想：中文“证据寥寥无几”最适合帮助记忆 scant，可以说 **scant evidence — “A court should be cautious about a serious accusation supported by only scant evidence.”**

quiz.question: __________ pedant
quiz.explanation: 学究; 书呆子, 吹毛求疵的学究. The nitpicking pedant corrected every minor error. 吹毛求疵的学究纠正每个小错误。 | pedant->教师（意大利pedagogo->教导），pedant->过分拘泥于书本的老师=学究（cf. pedagogy教学法，pedantic学究的） || 文化联想：中文“掉书袋、对小细节死抠的学究”最适合帮助记忆 pedant，可以说 **a nitpicking pedant — “Someone who interrupts every conversation to correct trivial terminology may come across as a nitpicking pedant.”**

quiz.question: _______ confidant
quiz.explanation: 密友; 知己, 值得信赖的密友. She shared her secrets with her trusted confidant. 她与她值得信赖的密友分享秘密。 | con->共同，fid->信任（拉丁fides），confidant->可以共同信任的人=知己（cf. confident自信的，confide信赖，fidelity忠诚） || 文化联想：中文“人生得一知己足矣”最适合帮助记忆 confidant，可以说 **a trusted confidant — “A trusted confidant is the person to whom someone can reveal private fears and hopes without hesitation.”**

quiz.question: ______ descendant
quiz.explanation: 后裔; 后代, 直系后代. He is a direct descendant of the founder. 他是创始人的直系后代。 | de->向下，scend->爬（拉丁scandere），descendant->向下爬的后代（cf. ascend上升，transcend超越，condescend屈尊） || 文化联想：中国族谱里追溯祖先和直系后代最适合帮助记忆 descendant，可以说 **a direct descendant — “A family genealogy may show that someone is a direct descendant of an ancestor who lived several centuries ago.”**

quiz.question: ________ defendant
quiz.explanation: 被告, 刑事被告. The criminal defendant pleaded not guilty. 刑事被告表示不认罪。 | de->加强，fend->防御（拉丁defendere），defendant->防御自己的人=被告（cf. defend防御，offense进攻，fend off抵挡） || 文化联想：中国法庭里的被告席最适合帮助记忆 defendant，可以说 **a criminal defendant — “A criminal defendant has the right to answer the charges and present a defense in court.”**

quiz.question: abundant ______
quiz.explanation: 丰富的; 充裕的, 充足的供应. The region has an abundant supply of fresh water. 该地区有充足的淡水供应。 | ab->离开/充满，und->水（拉丁unda->波浪），abundant->水浪涌出的=充裕的（cf. undulate波动，inundate淹没，redundant多余） || 文化联想：中文“物产丰富、供应充足”最适合帮助记忆 abundant，可以说 **an abundant supply — “A region with many rivers and reservoirs may have an abundant supply of fresh water.”**

quiz.question: verdant _____
quiz.explanation: 翠绿的; 青翠的, 翠绿的田野. Spring rains create verdant field landscapes. 春雨造就了翠绿的田野景观。 | verd->绿（拉丁viridis），verdant->绿意盎然的（cf. verdigris铜绿，verdure青翠，cf. verde西班牙语/意大利语的绿） || 文化联想：江南春雨后绿油油的稻田最适合帮助记忆 verdant，可以说 **verdant fields — “After spring rain, the rice paddies may stretch across the countryside as bright, verdant fields.”**

quiz.question: mordant ___
quiz.explanation: 尖刻的; 讽刺的, 尖刻的机智. His mordant wit could be quite cutting. 他尖刻的机智可能相当刺耳。 | mord->咬（拉丁mordere），mordant->像咬人一样尖刻的（cf. mordacious尖刻，remorse悔恨=再次咬，morsels碎片=咬一口） || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文辛辣尖锐的讽刺最适合帮助记忆 mordant，可以说 **mordant wit — “A satirical essay in the spirit of Lu Xun can use mordant wit to expose hypocrisy and absurdity.”**

quiz.question: ______ pageant
quiz.explanation: 选美; 盛典, 选美比赛. She competed in the beauty pageant last summer. 她去年夏天参加了选美比赛。 | pageant->活动舞台（中世纪拉丁pagina->舞台），pageant->盛大的展示/选美（cf. page页面，pageantry盛典，display展示） || 文化联想：中国大型电视选秀或形象比赛可帮助记忆 pageant，可以说 **a beauty pageant — “A contestant in a beauty pageant may be judged on presentation, interviews, and stage performance.”**

quiz.question: _____ litigant
quiz.explanation: 诉讼当事人, 民事诉讼当事人. The civil litigant filed a lawsuit for damages. 民事诉讼当事人提起损害赔偿诉讼。 | litig->争论（拉丁lis->诉讼），litigant->参与诉讼的人（cf. litigate诉讼，litigation诉讼，litigious好打官司的） || 文化联想：中文“打官司的一方当事人”最适合帮助记忆 litigant，可以说 **a civil litigant — “A civil litigant may file documents, present evidence, and argue a claim before the court.”**

quiz.question: enchant ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使着迷; 施魔法, 使人群着迷. The magicians tricks will enchant the crowd. 魔术师的戏法将使人群着迷。 | en->使，chant->歌唱（拉丁cantare），enchant->对着施魔法歌唱=迷住（cf. chant吟唱，disenchant使幻灭，incantation咒语） || 文化联想：桂林山水让游客看得入迷最适合帮助记忆 enchant，可以说 **enchant visitors — “The misty peaks and winding rivers of Guilin can enchant visitors with their unusual landscape.”**

quiz.question: penchant ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 嗜好; 倾向, 对爵士乐的嗜好. He has a penchant for jazz music. 他对爵士乐有嗜好。 | penchant->倾斜（法语pencher->倾斜），penchant->心倾向于某物=嗜好（cf. pendant悬挂，pendulum钟摆，depend依赖） || 文化联想：中国文人偏爱梅兰竹菊的传统最适合帮助记忆 penchant，可以说 **a penchant for bamboo — “A traditional scholar-painter may show a strong penchant for bamboo because of its cultural associations with integrity and resilience.”**

quiz.question: trenchant ________
quiz.explanation: 尖锐的; 鲜明的, 尖锐的批评. The reviewer wrote a trenchant critique of the film. 评论家对这部电影写了尖锐的批评。 | trench->切/挖（法语trancher->切），trenchant->像利刃切割的=尖锐的（cf. trench战壕，entrench巩固，retrench削减） || 文化联想：鲁迅式一针见血的社会批评最适合帮助记忆 trenchant，可以说 **a trenchant critique — “A sharply reasoned essay that exposes a social contradiction may offer a trenchant critique.”**

quiz.question: disenchant ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 使幻想破灭, 使公众幻想破灭. The scandal will disenchant the public with politics. 这起丑闻将使公众对政治幻想破灭。 | dis->去除，enchant->迷住，disenchant->去除魔法=使幻灭（cf. enchant迷住，disenchantment幻灭，disillusioned幻灭的） || 文化联想：中文“滤镜碎了、幻想破灭”最适合帮助记忆 disenchant，可以说 **disenchant the public — “A corruption scandal can disenchant the public by destroying an idealized image of an admired institution.”**

quiz.question: __________ sycophant
quiz.explanation: 马屁精; 谄媚者, 谄媚的马屁精. The obsequious sycophant flattered the boss constantly. 谄媚的马屁精不断奉承老板。 | syco->无花果，phant->显示（希腊），sycophant->原指告发无花果走私者=告密/拍马屁（cf. phantom幽灵，phenomenon现象） || 文化联想：中文“拍马屁的人”最适合帮助记忆 sycophant，可以说 **an obsequious sycophant — “An employee who praises every idea from the boss and never voices an honest disagreement may look like an obsequious sycophant.”**

quiz.question: insouciant _____
quiz.explanation: 漫不经心的; 无忧无虑的, 漫不经心的微笑. She wore an insouciant smile despite the troubles. 尽管有麻烦,她脸上还是带着漫不经心的微笑。 | in->否定，souciant->担忧（法语soucier->担心），insouciant->不担心的=漫不经心（cf. solicitous关心备至，nonchalant冷淡） || 文化联想：中文“一副云淡风轻、若无其事的样子”最适合帮助记忆 insouciant，可以说 **an insouciant smile — “Someone may wear an insouciant smile even while everyone else is worried about the approaching deadline.”**

quiz.question: valiant ______
quiz.explanation: 英勇的; 勇敢的, 英勇的努力. They made a valiant effort to save the company. 他们做出了拯救公司的英勇努力。 | val->强壮/价值（拉丁valere），valiant->有价值的勇气=英勇的（cf. valor英勇，valid有效，value价值，valorous英勇的） || 文化联想：抗洪抢险人员冒险救人的画面最适合帮助记忆 valiant，可以说 **a valiant effort — “Rescue workers may make a valiant effort to reach families trapped by rising floodwater.”**

quiz.question: ____ defoliant
quiz.explanation: 落叶剂, 落叶剂. Agent Orange was a powerful leaf defoliant used in war. 橙剂是战争中使用的强力落叶剂。 | de->去除，foli->叶（拉丁folium），ant->使...的物质，defoliant->使树叶脱落的药剂（cf. foliage叶子，portfolio文件夹） || 文化联想：中国棉花机械化采收前使用落叶剂的农业场景最适合帮助记忆 defoliant，可以说 **a cotton defoliant — “Before machine harvesting, farmers may use a cotton defoliant to encourage leaves to drop from the plants.”**

quiz.question: pliant ________
quiz.explanation: 柔软的; 易弯曲的, 柔韧的材料. Leather becomes pliant material when properly treated. 皮革经过适当处理后会变成柔韧的材料。 | pli->折叠（法语plier->折），pliant->可以折叠弯曲的（cf. comply遵从，supply供应，implicate牵连，pliable柔韧） || 文化联想：柳条柔软、能弯而不断最适合帮助记忆 pliant，可以说 **pliant willow branches — “Fresh willow branches are pliant enough to bend into curves without snapping easily.”**

quiz.question: compliant ________
quiz.explanation: 顺从的; 服从的, 顺从的行为. The regulations require compliant behavior from all staff. 法规要求所有员工有顺从的行为。 | com->共同，pli->折叠，compliant->弯曲以配合=顺从的（cf. comply遵从，compliance服从，pliable柔韧） || 文化联想：中国企业做合规审查最适合帮助记忆 compliant，可以说 **a compliant business — “A compliant business follows the regulations that govern safety, taxes, employment, and reporting.”**

quiz.question: ________ suppliant
quiz.explanation: 恳求的; 哀求者, 跪着的恳求者. The kneeling suppliant begged for forgiveness. 跪着的恳求者乞求宽恕。 | sup->向下，pli->弯曲，suppliant->向下弯曲跪求的人=恳求者（cf. supplicant同义，supplicate跪求，supplant取代） || 文化联想：古装剧里跪地苦苦哀求的形象最适合帮助记忆 suppliant，可以说 **a kneeling suppliant — “A prisoner begging a powerful official for mercy may appear as a kneeling suppliant.”**

quiz.question: luxuriant ______
quiz.explanation: 茂盛的; 丰富的, 茂盛的生长. The tropical rainforest shows luxuriant growth. 热带雨林显示出茂盛的生长。 | luxuri->奢侈/丰盛（拉丁luxus），luxuriant->丰盛茂盛的（注意luxuriant=茂盛，luxurious=奢华，cf. luxury奢侈） || 文化联想：西双版纳热带雨林植物茂密疯长的景象最适合帮助记忆 luxuriant，可以说 **luxuriant growth — “Warm rain and tropical humidity support luxuriant growth in the forests of Xishuangbanna.”**

quiz.question: deviant ________
quiz.explanation: 偏离的; 异常的, 偏离的行为. Psychologists study deviant behavior patterns. 心理学家研究偏离的行为模式。 | de->离开，vi->路（拉丁via），deviant->偏离道路的=异常的（cf. deviate偏离，obvious明显，devious迂回） || 文化联想：中文“偏离正常轨道的行为”最适合帮助记忆 deviant，可以说 **deviant behavior — “A sociologist may study behavior considered deviant because it departs sharply from accepted social norms.”**

quiz.question: nonchalant ________
quiz.explanation: 冷淡的; 漠不关心的, 冷淡的态度. His nonchalant attitude masked deep concerns. 他冷淡的态度掩盖了深深的担忧。 | non->否定，chalant->热（法语chaloir->在乎），nonchalant->不在乎的=漠不关心（cf. insouciant无忧无虑，cool冷静） || 文化联想：中文“泰山崩于前而色不变、表面若无其事”最适合帮助记忆 nonchalant，可以说 **a nonchalant attitude — “Even under intense pressure, an experienced negotiator may maintain a nonchalant attitude and speak calmly.”**

quiz.question: sibilant ____
quiz.explanation: 咝咝作响的, 咝咝的嘶嘶声. The snake made a sibilant hiss as a warning. 蛇发出咝咝的嘶嘶声作为警告。 | sibilant->发出咝咝声（拉丁sibilare->嘶嘶），sibilant->咝咝的（cf. hiss嘶嘶声，whisper低语，sibilant sounds如s/sh/z音） || 文化联想：蛇吐信子时“嘶嘶”作响最适合帮助记忆 sibilant，可以说 **a sibilant hiss — “A snake disturbed beside a trail may produce a sibilant hiss as a warning.”**

quiz.question: jubilant _____
quiz.explanation: 欢欣鼓舞的, 欢欣鼓舞的人群. The jubilant crowd celebrated the teams victory. 欢欣鼓舞的人群庆祝球队的胜利。 | jubil->欢呼（希伯来语yobel->羊角号），jubilant->欢腾的（cf. jubilee周年庆典=50年吹号庆祝，jubilation欢腾） || 文化联想：中国队夺冠后全场沸腾最适合帮助记忆 jubilant，可以说 **a jubilant crowd — “A jubilant crowd may wave flags and cheer after the national team wins a major final.”**

quiz.question: vigilant _____
quiz.explanation: 警惕的; 警觉的, 警惕的监视. Security maintains a vigilant watch over the premises. 保安对场所保持警惕的监视。 | vigil->守夜（拉丁vigil->醒着），vigilant->保持清醒警惕的（cf. vigil守夜，vigor活力，vigilante私刑者） || 文化联想：中文“居安思危、时刻警惕”最适合帮助记忆 vigilant，可以说 **remain vigilant — “Even during a quiet flood season, emergency crews must remain vigilant and monitor changing weather.”**

quiz.question: implant ______
quiz.explanation: 植入; 灌输, 植入装置. The surgeon inserted an implant device in the patient. 外科医生在患者体内插入了植入装置。 | im->进入，plant->种植，implant->植入/灌输（cf. transplant移植，supplant取代，plant种植） || 文化联想：中国医院给听障患者做人工耳蜗植入最适合帮助记忆 implant，可以说 **a cochlear implant — “A patient with severe hearing loss may receive a cochlear implant after specialist evaluation.”**

quiz.question: supplant _ ______
quiz.explanation: 取代; 代替, 取代领导者. The coup attempt sought to supplant a leader. 政变企图试图取代领导者。 | sub->从下，plant->脚（拉丁planta），supplant->从脚下绊倒取代=取代（cf. plant种植，implant植入，transplant移植） || 文化联想：中文“新技术取代旧技术”最适合帮助记忆 supplant，可以说 **supplant an older technology — “A more efficient technology may gradually supplant an older technology once costs fall and adoption grows.”**

quiz.question: _____ coagulant
quiz.explanation: 凝结剂, 血液凝固剂. The blood coagulant helps stop excessive bleeding. 血液凝固剂有助于止血。 | coagul->凝固（拉丁coagulare），coagulant->使凝固的物质（cf. coagulate凝固，blood clot血凝块，coagulation凝血） || 文化联想：中国做豆腐用石膏或卤水使豆浆凝结最适合帮助记忆 coagulant，可以说 **a tofu coagulant — “Traditional tofu making uses a coagulant to turn hot soy milk into soft curds.”**

quiz.question: petulant _____
quiz.explanation: 任性的; 脾气坏的, 任性的孩子. The petulant child threw a tantrum in the store. 任性的孩子在商店里发脾气。 | petul->攻击/索求（拉丁petere），petulant->任性地攻击要求的（cf. impetuous冲动，petition请求，compete竞争） || 文化联想：中文“小孩撒泼、闹脾气”最适合帮助记忆 petulant，可以说 **a petulant child — “A petulant child may throw a tantrum in a shop after being told that no more toys will be bought.”**

quiz.question: dormant _______
quiz.explanation: 休眠的; 静止的, 休眠的火山. Scientists monitor the dormant volcano for activity. 科学家监测休眠火山的活动。 | dorm->睡眠（拉丁dormire），dormant->沉睡的=休眠的（cf. dormitory宿舍，dormouse睡鼠，dormition安眠） || 文化联想：中国地理课里的休眠火山最适合帮助记忆 dormant，可以说 **a dormant volcano — “A dormant volcano may remain quiet for a very long time even though geologists still monitor it for activity.”**

quiz.question: _________ tenant
quiz.explanation: 房客; 承租人, 公寓租户. The apartment tenant pays rent on the first of each month. 公寓租户每月一号支付租金。 | ten->持有（拉丁tenere），tenant->持有土地的人=租户（cf. tenacious顽强，tenure任期，retain保留） || 文化联想：中国租房时每月交房租的房客最适合帮助记忆 tenant，可以说 **an apartment tenant — “An apartment tenant usually pays rent and follows the terms of the lease.”**

quiz.question: _______ covenant
quiz.explanation: 契约; 盟约, 有约束力的契约. They signed a binding covenant to share resources. 他们签署了一项有约束力的资源共享契约。 | con->共同，vent->来（拉丁venire），covenant->共同来到/约定（cf. convention惯例，convene召集，convent修道院） || 文化联想：中文“立下共同遵守的盟约”最适合帮助记忆 covenant，可以说 **a binding covenant — “Two communities may sign a binding covenant promising to share water and protect the same watershed.”**

quiz.question: stagnant ____
quiz.explanation: 停滞的; 不流动的, 停滞的水池. Mosquitoes breed in stagnant pool water. 蚊子在停滞的水池中繁殖。 | stagn->死水（拉丁stagnum->水池），stagnant->像死水一样停滞的（cf. stagnate停滞，stagnation停滞，stagnant economy萧条经济） || 文化联想：中文“一潭死水”最适合帮助记忆 stagnant，可以说 **stagnant water — “A neglected pond with no circulation may become stagnant water where mosquitoes breed easily.”**

quiz.question: pregnant _____
quiz.explanation: 怀孕的; 意味深长的, 意味深长的停顿. There was a pregnant pause before she answered. 她回答前有一个意味深长的停顿。 | preg->之前/充满，nat->出生，pregnant->充满/有孕的（cf. prenatal出生前，nation国家，pregnant pause意味深长） || 文化联想：中文“欲言又止、意味深长地停顿一下”最适合帮助记忆 pregnant，可以说 **a pregnant pause — “When asked an awkward question, a speaker may leave a pregnant pause before choosing the next words.”**

quiz.question: malignant _____
quiz.explanation: 恶性的; 有害的, 恶性肿瘤. The biopsy revealed a malignant tumor. 活检显示有恶性肿瘤。 | mal->坏，lign->出生/本性（拉丁），malignant->本性邪恶的=恶性的（cf. benign良性，malign中伤，malignancy恶性肿瘤） || 文化联想：中国医院肿瘤科最熟悉的“恶性肿瘤”最适合帮助记忆 malignant，可以说 **a malignant tumor — “A biopsy may determine whether a tumor is benign or malignant.”**

quiz.question: poignant _____
quiz.explanation: 辛酸的; 深刻的, 辛酸的场景. The movies ending featured a poignant scene. 电影的结局有一个辛酸的场景。 | poign->刺（法语poindre，拉丁pungere），poignant->像刺一样触动心灵的=辛酸（cf. puncture刺穿，pungent刺鼻，poignancy辛酸） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里黛玉葬花的哀伤画面最适合帮助记忆 poignant，可以说 **a poignant scene — “Daiyu burying fallen blossoms in Dream of the Red Chamber is a poignant scene filled with beauty, fragility, and sorrow.”**

quiz.question: repugnant ___
quiz.explanation: 令人厌恶的; 可憎的, 令人厌恶的行为. The crime was a repugnant act that shocked everyone. 这起犯罪是令人厌恶的行为,震惊了所有人。 | re->对抗，pugn->拳（拉丁pugnus），repugnant->对抗排斥的=令人厌恶（cf. pugnacious好斗，impugn质疑，pugilist拳击手） || 文化联想：中文“令人作呕、道德上无法接受”最适合帮助记忆 repugnant，可以说 **a repugnant act — “Deliberately cheating vulnerable elderly people out of their savings is a repugnant act.”**

quiz.question: dominant ________
quiz.explanation: 占优势的; 支配的, 主导地位. The company holds a dominant position in the market. 该公司在市场上占据主导地位。 | domin->主人（拉丁dominus），dominant->像主人一样支配的（cf. domain领域，dominate支配，predominant占优势的） || 文化联想：中文“占据主导地位”最适合帮助记忆 dominant，可以说 **a dominant position — “A company with overwhelming market share may hold a dominant position in its industry.”**

quiz.question: predominant ______
quiz.explanation: 主要的; 占优势的, 主要因素. Price was the predominant factor in their decision. 价格是他们决定的主要因素。 | pre->提前/更，dominant->支配的，predominant->更加支配的=主要的（cf. dominant支配，dominate支配，predominance优势） || 文化联想：春节街头和年画里红色最显眼的视觉印象最适合帮助记忆 predominant，可以说 **a predominant color — “Red is often the predominant color in Spring Festival decorations because of its strong festive associations.”**

quiz.question: ___ determinant
quiz.explanation: 决定因素, 关键决定因素. Education is a key determinant of success. 教育是成功的关键决定因素。 | de->彻底，termin->边界/结束，determinant->决定边界的因素（cf. determine决定，terminal终端，exterminate消灭） || 文化联想：中文“地段是房价的重要决定因素”最适合帮助记忆 determinant，可以说 **a key determinant — “Location can be a key determinant of housing prices because it affects schools, commuting, amenities, and demand.”**

quiz.question: ruminant ______
quiz.explanation: 反刍动物, 反刍动物. Cows are ruminant animal with multiple stomach chambers. 牛是有多个胃室的反刍动物。 | rumin->喉咙/反刍（拉丁rumen->前胃），ruminant->反复咀嚼的动物（cf. ruminate沉思=反复咀嚼，ruminant vs. rumination深思） || 文化联想：内蒙古草原上的牛羊最适合帮助记忆 ruminant，可以说 **a ruminant animal — “A cow on the grasslands is a ruminant animal that chews cud after grazing.”**

quiz.question: ____ pennant
quiz.explanation: 锦旗; 三角旗, 球队锦旗. The baseball team pennant hung in the stadium. 棒球队锦旗悬挂在体育场。 | penn->羽毛/旗（拉丁penna->羽毛），pennant->像羽毛飘扬的小旗（cf. pen钢笔=羽毛笔，pennon旗帜，pinion翅膀） || 文化联想：中国运动会或学校比赛里飘扬的小三角队旗最适合帮助记忆 pennant，可以说 **a team pennant — “Supporters may wave a team pennant from the stands during an important school match.”**

quiz.question: resonant _____
quiz.explanation: 共鸣的; 洪亮的, 洪亮的声音. His resonant voice filled the concert hall. 他洪亮的声音充满了音乐厅。 | re->回，son->声音，resonant->声音回响的=共鸣的（cf. sound声音，sonic声音的，resonate共鸣，sonorous洪亮） || 文化联想：寺庙大钟敲响后余音回荡最适合帮助记忆 resonant，可以说 **a resonant sound — “A large temple bell can produce a deep, resonant sound that seems to linger in the courtyard.”**

quiz.question: consonant _______
quiz.explanation: 辅音; 一致的, 辅音群. English has many consonant cluster combinations. 英语有许多辅音群组合。 | con->共同，son->声音，consonant->共同发声=辅音/一致的（cf. resonant共鸣，dissonant不和谐，assonance元音押韵） || 文化联想：中国学生学英语发音时遇到连续辅音最适合帮助记忆 consonant，可以说 **a consonant cluster — “An English learner may practice a consonant cluster such as the sounds at the beginning of ‘street.’”**

quiz.question: dissonant _____
quiz.explanation: 不和谐的; 刺耳的, 不和谐的和弦. The composer used a dissonant chord for tension. 作曲家使用不和谐的和弦来制造紧张感。 | dis->分开，son->声音，dissonant->声音分离不和谐的（cf. consonant辅音/一致，resonant共鸣，dissonance不和谐） || 文化联想：音乐课里故意使用刺耳不协和和弦制造紧张感最适合帮助记忆 dissonant，可以说 **a dissonant chord — “A composer may use a dissonant chord to create tension before resolving it into a more stable harmony.”**

quiz.question: rampant _____
quiz.explanation: 猖獗的; 蔓延的, 猖獗的犯罪. Rampant crime plagued the neighborhood. 猖獗的犯罪困扰着这个社区。 | ramp->爬升（古法语ramper->爬），rampant->像爬坡一样蔓延的=猖獗的（cf. ramp斜坡，rampage狂暴，rampart城墙） || 文化联想：中文“谣言猖獗、到处蔓延”最适合帮助记忆 rampant，可以说 **rampant rumors — “During a crisis, rampant rumors can spread faster than verified information on social media.”**

quiz.question: flippant ______
quiz.explanation: 轻率的; 无礼的, 轻率的评论. His flippant remark offended the grieving family. 他轻率的评论冒犯了悲伤的家人。 | flip->轻弹（象声词），flippant->像轻弹一样轻率的（cf. flip轻弹，flip side反面，flippancy轻率，flipper鳍肢） || 文化联想：中文“在庄重场合轻佻开玩笑”最适合帮助记忆 flippant，可以说 **a flippant remark — “Making a joke at a solemn memorial can sound like a flippant remark and offend grieving relatives.”**

quiz.question: rant ______
quiz.explanation: 咆哮; 激烈演说, 激烈演说. The politician delivered an angry rant speech. 这位政客发表了愤怒的激烈演说。 | rant->咆哮（荷兰语ranten->说胡话），rant->激烈咆哮（cf. rant and rave大发雷霆，ranting咆哮） || 文化联想：中文“站在台上气急败坏地一通咆哮”最适合帮助记忆 rant，可以说 **an angry rant — “A speaker who abandons argument and simply shouts accusations may launch into an angry rant.”**

quiz.question: vibrant _________
quiz.explanation: 充满活力的; 鲜艳的, 充满活力的社区. The city has a vibrant community of artists. 这座城市有一个充满活力的艺术家社区。 | vibr->振动（拉丁vibrare），vibrant->充满振动活力的（cf. vibrate振动，vibration震动，vivid生动） || 文化联想：成都夜市人声鼎沸、店铺林立的活力最适合帮助记忆 vibrant，可以说 **a vibrant neighborhood — “A Chengdu neighborhood filled with teahouses, food stalls, music, and late-night crowds can feel vibrant and energetic.”**

quiz.question: ______ hydrant
quiz.explanation: 消防栓, 街道消防栓. Firefighters connected hoses to the street hydrant. 消防员将水管连接到街道消防栓。 | hydr->水（希腊hydor），ant->装置，hydrant->出水装置=消防栓（cf. hydraulic液压，hydrogen氢=产水元素，dehydrate脱水） || 文化联想：中国小区街边消防栓最适合帮助记忆 hydrant，可以说 **a street hydrant — “Firefighters may connect a hose to a street hydrant when responding to a building fire.”**

quiz.question: _ preponderant _____
quiz.explanation: 占优势的; 主要的, 主要份额. He inherited a preponderant share of the estate. 他继承了遗产的主要份额。 | pre->超过，ponder->重量（拉丁），preponderant->重量超过的=占优势的（cf. ponder思考，ponderous沉重，preponderance优势） || 文化联想：中文“占了绝大部分”最适合帮助记忆 preponderant，可以说 **a preponderant share — “One heir may receive a preponderant share of an estate if the legal documents allocate most of the property to that person.”**

quiz.question: itinerant ______
quiz.explanation: 巡回的; 流动的, 流动工人. The itinerant worker traveled from farm to farm. 流动工人从一个农场到另一个农场。 | iter->旅程（拉丁iter->旅程），itinerant->不断旅行的=流动的（cf. itinerary行程，reiterate重复=再走一遍，exit出口） || 文化联想：古代走街串巷、四处谋生的货郎最适合帮助记忆 itinerant，可以说 **an itinerant peddler — “An itinerant peddler may travel from village to village selling small household goods.”**

quiz.question: __________ grant
quiz.explanation: 授予; 拨款, 政府拨款. The research was funded by a government grant. 这项研究由政府拨款资助。 | grant->给予（古法语granter），grant->授予/拨款（cf. guarantee保证，warant授权，take for granted认为理所当然） || 文化联想：中国科研项目申请政府科研经费最适合帮助记忆 grant，可以说 **a research grant — “A university laboratory may receive a government research grant to fund equipment, staff, and experiments.”**

quiz.question: fragrant _______
quiz.explanation: 芳香的; 香的, 芳香的花朵. Spring brings fragrant blossom to the gardens. 春天给花园带来芳香的花朵。 | fragr->香气（拉丁fragrare->散发香气），fragrant->散发香气的（cf. flagrant明目张胆=像火焰一样显眼，同根不同义） || 文化联想：桂花飘香最适合帮助记忆 fragrant，可以说 **fragrant osmanthus — “In early autumn, fragrant osmanthus can fill a Chinese garden with a sweet scent.”**

quiz.question: ____________ aspirant
quiz.explanation: 有抱负者; 候选人, 总统候选人. The presidential aspirant announced his campaign. 总统候选人宣布了他的竞选活动。 | aspir->呼吸/向往（拉丁aspirare），aspirant->向往某个目标的人（cf. aspire向往，aspiration抱负，inspire激励） || 文化联想：中国年轻运动员以奥运会为目标训练最适合帮助记忆 aspirant，可以说 **an Olympic aspirant — “A young Chinese athlete may train for years as an Olympic aspirant hoping to qualify for the national team.”**

quiz.question: ______ warrant
quiz.explanation: 授权; 搜查令, 搜查令. Police obtained a search warrant for the premises. 警方获得了对该场所的搜查令。 | warrant->保证（古法语warantir->保护），warrant->授权/搜查令（cf. guarantee保证，warranty保修，warranted有依据的） || 文化联想：warrant 是英美法律中的搜查令，可用中国法学生学习美国刑事程序时来记忆，可以说 **a search warrant — “A Chinese law student may learn that police in the United States generally need a valid search warrant for many searches of private premises.”**

quiz.question: aberrant ________
quiz.explanation: 异常的; 偏离的, 异常行为. The psychologist studied aberrant behavior patterns. 心理学家研究异常行为模式。 | ab->偏离，err->走/错，aberrant->偏离正途的=异常的（cf. err犯错，error错误，aberration偏差，errant漫游的） || 文化联想：中文“异常得不合常理”最适合帮助记忆 aberrant，可以说 **an aberrant pattern — “A scientist may investigate an aberrant pattern in the data because it differs sharply from all previous observations.”**

quiz.question: recalcitrant _____
quiz.explanation: 顽固的; 不服从的, 顽固的孩子. The recalcitrant child refused all discipline. 顽固的孩子拒绝所有纪律。 | re->回，calcitrant->踢（拉丁calcitrare->用脚后跟踢），recalcitrant->一直往后踢=顽固不服从（cf. calculus微积分，calcium钙=石头） || 文化联想：中文“犟得像头牛、怎么劝也不听”最适合帮助记忆 recalcitrant，可以说 **a recalcitrant child — “A recalcitrant child may resist every instruction and deliberately refuse to cooperate.”**

quiz.question: _____ tyrant
quiz.explanation: 暴君; 专制君主, 残酷的暴君. The cruel tyrant oppressed his people for decades. 残酷的暴君压迫他的人民数十年。 | tyrant->暴君（希腊tyrannos->君主），tyrant->专制暴君（cf. tyranny暴政，tyrannical专制的，cf. originally neutral then negative） || 文化联想：中国传统叙事中的桀、纣常被塑造成暴君形象，最适合帮助记忆 tyrant，可以说 **a cruel tyrant — “Traditional historical storytelling often portrays Jie or Zhou as a cruel tyrant who abused power and harmed the people.”**

quiz.question: ______ complaisant
quiz.explanation: 殷勤的; 讨好的, 过分殷勤的. His overly complaisant manner seemed insincere. 他过分殷勤的态度似乎不真诚。 | com->共同，plais->取悦（法语，拉丁placere），complaisant->竭力取悦的=殷勤的（cf. complacent自满，complain抱怨，please取悦） || 文化联想：中文“过分好说话、总想讨好别人”最适合帮助记忆 complaisant，可以说 **an overly complaisant manner — “Someone who agrees with every request merely to please others may develop an overly complaisant manner.”**

quiz.question: conversant ____
quiz.explanation: 熟悉的; 精通的, 熟悉. She is conversant with current technology trends. 她熟悉当前的技术趋势。 | convers->交谈（拉丁conversari），conversant->通过交谈熟悉的=精通（cf. converse交谈，conversation对话，convert转变） || 文化联想：中文“对一个领域很熟悉”最适合帮助记忆 conversant，可以说 **conversant with technology — “A software engineer should be conversant with the tools and technologies used by the team.”**

quiz.question: incessant _____
quiz.explanation: 不断的; 持续的, 不断的噪音. The incessant noise made it impossible to concentrate. 不断的噪音使人无法集中注意力。 | in->否定，cess->停止（拉丁cessare），incessant->不停止的（cf. cease停止，recess休息，concession让步，incessantly不停地） || 文化联想：中国夏天窗外蝉鸣没完没了最适合帮助记忆 incessant，可以说 **incessant noise — “The incessant noise of cicadas on a hot summer afternoon can make a quiet room feel surprisingly loud.”**

quiz.question: ___ depressant
quiz.explanation: 抑制剂; 镇静剂, 使用镇静剂. Doctors may use depressant medications carefully. 医生可能会谨慎使用镇静剂药物。 | de->向下，press->压，depressant->向下压制的物质=镇静剂（cf. depress使沮丧，suppress压制，stimulant兴奋剂=反义） || 文化联想：depressant 是中枢抑制类药物，可用中国医院谨慎用药的场景来记忆，可以说 **a central nervous system depressant — “A doctor may prescribe a central nervous system depressant only when its benefits and risks have been carefully considered.”**

quiz.question: puissant _____
quiz.explanation: 强大的; 有力的, 强大的国家. The puissant state dominated regional politics. 强大的国家主导了区域政治。 | puiss->力量（法语pouvoir->能够），puissant->强大有力的（cf. power力量，possible可能，puissance力量，impotent无力的） || 文化联想：中文“国力强盛”最适合帮助记忆 puissant，可以说 **a puissant state — “At the height of a prosperous dynasty, a state with strong finances, armies, and administration may appear puissant.”**

quiz.question: blatant ___
quiz.explanation: 明目张胆的; 公然的, 明目张胆的谎言. His testimony was a blatant lie. 他的证词是明目张胆的谎言。 | blatant->来自Spenser《仙后》的怪兽Blatant Beast（叫声响亮），blatant->公然嚣张的（cf. bleat羊叫，flagrant公然的） || 文化联想：中文“睁眼说瞎话、明目张胆的谎言”最适合帮助记忆 blatant，可以说 **a blatant lie — “Claiming that an event never happened despite clear video evidence would be a blatant lie.”**

quiz.question: ________ reactant
quiz.explanation: 反应物, 化学反应物. The chemical reactant was added to the solution. 化学反应物被加入溶液中。 | re->回，act->行动，reactant->在反应中起作用的物质=反应物（cf. react反应，reaction反应，reagent试剂） || 文化联想：中国中学化学实验把反应物加入烧杯最适合帮助记忆 reactant，可以说 **a chemical reactant — “A student may add a chemical reactant to a solution and observe a color change or precipitate.”**

quiz.question: ___ disinfectant
quiz.explanation: 消毒剂, 使用消毒剂. Always use disinfectant on contaminated surfaces. 始终在受污染的表面使用消毒剂。 | dis->去除，infect->感染，ant->物质，disinfectant->去除感染的物质=消毒剂（cf. disinfect消毒，antiseptic防腐剂） || 文化联想：中国家庭清洁卫生间时使用消毒剂最适合帮助记忆 disinfectant，可以说 **use disinfectant — “A family may use disinfectant on frequently touched bathroom surfaces during flu season.”**

quiz.question: ____ inhabitant
quiz.explanation: 居民, 城市居民. The city inhabitant enjoys urban amenities. 城市居民享受城市便利设施。 | in->在内，habit->居住（拉丁），ant->人，inhabitant->在里面居住的人=居民（cf. habitat栖息地，inhabit居住，habitual习惯的） || 文化联想：中文“城市居民”最适合帮助记忆 inhabitant，可以说 **a city inhabitant — “A city inhabitant may rely on public transit, apartment living, and nearby services for everyday life.”**

quiz.question: exorbitant _____
quiz.explanation: 过高的; 过分的, 过高的价格. The hotel charged an exorbitant price for the room. 酒店对房间收取了过高的价格。 | ex->超出，orbit->轨道（拉丁orbita），exorbitant->超出轨道的=过分的（cf. orbit轨道，orbital轨道的，exorbitance过度） || 文化联想：中文“天价”最适合帮助记忆 exorbitant，可以说 **an exorbitant price — “A tiny hotel room during a major holiday may be offered at an exorbitant price—让人觉得简直是‘天价.’”**

quiz.question: incogitant ______
quiz.explanation: 考虑不周的; 轻率的, 轻率的评论. His incogitant remark caused unnecessary offense. 他轻率的评论造成了不必要的冒犯。 | in->否定，cogit->思考（拉丁cogitare），incogitant->不加思考的=轻率的（cf. cogitate思考，cognitive认知，cogent有说服力的） || 文化联想：中文“话不过脑子就说出口”最适合帮助记忆 incogitant，可以说 **an incogitant remark — “Blurting out a criticism at a family dinner without thinking can become an incogitant remark that needlessly hurts someone.”**

quiz.question: concomitant _______
quiz.explanation: 伴随的; 同时发生的, 伴随的影响. The treatment has several concomitant effects. 这种治疗有几种伴随的影响。 | con->共同，comit->陪伴（拉丁comitari），concomitant->共同陪伴的=伴随的（cf. accompany陪伴，committee委员会，count伯爵） || 文化联想：中国人吃药时常会关注“伴随作用”，最适合帮助记忆 concomitant，可以说 **concomitant effects — “A treatment may bring concomitant effects that appear alongside its main therapeutic benefit.”**

quiz.question: precipitant ________
quiz.explanation: 沉淀剂; 仓促的, 添加沉淀剂. The precipitant addition caused the chemical reaction. 添加沉淀剂引起了化学反应。 | pre->向前，cipit->头（拉丁caput），precipitant->头朝前冲的=仓促/沉淀剂（cf. precipice悬崖，precipitation降水，capital首都） || 文化联想：中国中学化学实验里加入沉淀剂最适合帮助记忆 precipitant，可以说 **a precipitant reagent — “In a chemistry lab, a student may add a precipitant reagent to make dissolved ions form a visible solid.”**

quiz.question: unrepentant ______
quiz.explanation: 不悔改的; 顽固的, 不悔改的罪人. The unrepentant sinner refused to admit wrongdoing. 不悔改的罪人拒绝承认错误。 | un->否定，repent->悔恨（拉丁poenitere），unrepentant->不悔恨的（cf. penitent悔罪的，repent悔改，penal惩罚） || 文化联想：中文“死不悔改”最适合帮助记忆 unrepentant，可以说 **an unrepentant wrongdoer — “Someone who admits causing harm but still refuses to apologize may remain an unrepentant wrongdoer.”**

quiz.question: distant ________
quiz.explanation: 遥远的; 疏远的, 远房亲戚. She met a distant relative at the family reunion. 她在家庭聚会上遇见了一个远房亲戚。 | di->分开，stant->站立（拉丁stare），distant->站得很远的=遥远的（cf. distance距离，instant立即=站在当下，constant恒定） || 文化联想：春节大家族聚会偶尔会见到多年没见的远房亲戚，最适合帮助记忆 distant，可以说 **a distant relative — “At a large Spring Festival reunion, someone may suddenly meet a distant relative from another province.”**

quiz.question: constant ________
quiz.explanation: 恒定的; 不变的, 恒定速度. The object moved at constant velocity. 物体以恒定速度移动。 | con->一起，stant->站立，constant->始终站在那里=恒定的（cf. instant立即，distant遥远，stance立场，circumstance情况） || 文化联想：中国中学物理课学习匀速运动最适合帮助记忆 constant，可以说 **constant velocity — “A physics problem may describe a train moving at constant velocity along a straight track.”**

quiz.question: _____ extant
quiz.explanation: 现存的; 尚存的, 仍然现存的. The manuscripts are still extant in the library. 这些手稿仍然现存于图书馆中。 | ex->向外，stant->站立，extant->仍然站立着的=现存的（cf. exist存在，extinct灭绝=不再站立，constant恒定） || 文化联想：敦煌保存下来的古代文书最适合帮助记忆 extant，可以说 **an extant manuscript — “An extant manuscript from Dunhuang can preserve words written more than a thousand years ago.”**

quiz.question: ________ sextant
quiz.explanation: 六分仪, 航海六分仪. Sailors use a nautical sextant to navigate by stars. 水手使用航海六分仪通过星星导航。 | sext->六分之一（拉丁sextus->第六），sextant->测量六分之一圆弧的仪器=六分仪（cf. sextet六重奏，sixtieth第六十） || 文化联想：六分仪不是中国传统航海仪器，可用中国现代帆船课学习天文导航来记忆 sextant，可以说 **a nautical sextant — “A student in a sailing course may learn to use a nautical sextant to measure the angle of a celestial body above the horizon.”**

quiz.question: piquant ______
quiz.explanation: 辛辣的; 开胃的, 开胃的味道. The sauce has a piquant flavor that tingles the tongue. 这种酱汁有一种刺激舌头的开胃味道。 | piquer->刺（法语），piquant->有刺激性的=辛辣开胃的（cf. pique刺激，pike矛/梭鱼，picket尖桩/警戒线） || 文化联想：四川泡椒和酸辣小菜那种辛香开胃的味道最适合帮助记忆 piquant，可以说 **a piquant flavor — “Pickled chilies can give a Sichuan side dish a piquant flavor that is sharp, lively, and appetizing.”**

quiz.question: ______ truant
quiz.explanation: 逃学者, 逃学者. The school truant was caught by authorities. 逃学者被当局抓获。 | truant->游荡者（威尔士语truan->可怜的人），truant->逃学游荡的人（cf. play truant逃学，vagrant流浪者） || 文化联想：中文“逃学去网吧”这个熟悉画面最适合帮助记忆 truant，可以说 **a school truant — “A school truant may skip class and spend the afternoon somewhere the teachers do not expect to find him.”**

quiz.question: _______ savant
quiz.explanation: 学者; 专家, 博学的学者. The learned savant published groundbreaking research. 博学的学者发表了开创性的研究。 | savant->知道（法语savoir->知道），savant->博学者（cf. savvy精明，sage智者，idiot savant白痴学者） || 文化联想：中文“博学鸿儒”最适合帮助记忆 savant，可以说 **a learned savant — “A scholar who has mastered several fields and can discuss them deeply may be regarded as a learned savant.”**

quiz.question: flamboyant _____
quiz.explanation: 艳丽的; 炫耀的, 炫耀的风格. The artist is known for his flamboyant style. 这位艺术家以其炫耀的风格而闻名。 | flamb->火焰（法语flambe），flamboyant->像火焰一样炫耀的（cf. flame火焰，flambé火焰烹饪，flamingo红鹤=像火焰的鸟） || 文化联想：春晚舞台上极其抢眼的亮片服装最适合帮助记忆 flamboyant，可以说 **a flamboyant style — “A performer in a television gala may adopt a flamboyant style with brilliant colors, dramatic shapes, and sparkling decoration.”**

quiz.question: buoyant ______
quiz.explanation: 有浮力的; 活跃的, 活跃的市场. Investors are optimistic about the buoyant market. 投资者对活跃的市场持乐观态度。 | buoy->浮标（荷兰语boei），buoyant->像浮标一样上浮的=有浮力/活跃的（cf. buoy浮标，buoyancy浮力，float漂浮） || 文化联想：中文财经里“市场情绪活跃、行情向上”最适合帮助记忆 buoyant，可以说 **a buoyant market — “Strong earnings and rising confidence can keep the stock market buoyant for a period.”**

quiz.question: ______ clairvoyant
quiz.explanation: 有透视能力的; 有洞察力的, 有天赋的千里眼. The gifted clairvoyant predicted future events. 有天赋的千里眼预测了未来事件。 | clair->清楚（法语clair->clear），voyant->看（voir->看），clairvoyant->清晰地看=千里眼（cf. clear清楚，voyage旅程，voyeur偷窥者） || 文化联想：clairvoyant 是西方“千里眼/灵视者”概念，可用中国学生读西方神秘题材小说时来记忆，可以说 **a clairvoyant character — “In a fantasy novel, a clairvoyant character may claim to see events that ordinary people cannot perceive.”**

quiz.question: cognizant __ ____
quiz.explanation: 认识到的; 察觉到的, 察觉到事实. Everyone should be cognizant of fact before deciding. 每个人在决定前都应该察觉到事实。 | cogniz->知道（拉丁cognoscere），cognizant->已经知晓的=察觉的（cf. cognition认知，recognize认识，incognito匿名） || 文化联想：中文“心中有数”最适合帮助记忆 cognizant，可以说 **be cognizant of risk — “Before making a large investment, a careful buyer should be cognizant of risk rather than looking only at possible gains.”**

quiz.question: _______ bent
quiz.explanation: 倾向; 天赋, 天生的倾向. She has a natural bent for mathematics. 她对数学有天生的倾向。 | bent->弯曲的/倾向（bend的过去式），bent->天生的倾向（cf. bend弯曲，unbent坚定，bent on下定决心） || 文化联想：中文“天生对数学有感觉”最适合帮助记忆 bent，可以说 **a natural bent — “A child who enjoys puzzles and numbers from an early age may show a natural bent for mathematics.”**

quiz.question: adjacent ____

quiz.question: maleficent _____

quiz.question: magnificent _____

quiz.question: reticent _____

quiz.question: nascent ________

quiz.question: renascent ________
quiz.explanation: 复兴的; 新生的, 复兴的产业. quiz.question: ____ __ descent

quiz.question: iridescent ________

quiz.question: quiescent _______

quiz.question: convalescent ____
quiz.explanation: 康复期的; 恢复健康的, 康复之家. quiz.question: adolescent __________
quiz.explanation: 青春期的; 青少年, 青少年心理学. quiz.question: obsolescent ____

quiz.question: evanescent ____
quiz.explanation: 短暂的; 逐渐消失的, 短暂的光辉. quiz.question: fluorescent _____
quiz.explanation: 荧光的, 荧光灯. quiz.question: __________ antecedent
quiz.explanation: 前情; 先例, 历史先例. quiz.question: diffident _____

quiz.question: strident ____
quiz.explanation: 刺耳的; 尖锐的, 尖锐的语气. quiz.question: resident _____

quiz.question: _________ dissident
quiz.explanation: 持不同政见者, 政治异见者. quiz.question: provident ____
quiz.explanation: 有远见的; 节俭的, 公积金. quiz.question: transcendent ______
quiz.explanation: 超越的; 卓越的, 超凡的美丽. quiz.question: resplendent _____

quiz.question: pendent ______

quiz.question: indent _________

quiz.question: ____ despondent

quiz.question: ______ respondent

quiz.question: ardent _________

quiz.question: impudent ______
quiz.explanation: 无礼的; 放肆的, 无礼的评论. quiz.question: prudent ________

quiz.question: imprudent ________

quiz.question: ________ reagent
quiz.explanation: 试剂, 化学试剂. quiz.question: _____ regent
quiz.explanation: 摄政者, 皇家摄政. quiz.question: indigent ______

quiz.question: intransigent ______
quiz.explanation: 不妥协的; 固执的, 不妥协的立场. quiz.question: exigent _____________

quiz.question: refulgent _____
quiz.explanation: 灿烂的; 辉煌的, 灿烂的光芒. The diamond sparkled with refulgent light. 钻石闪耀着灿烂的光芒。 | re->加强，fulg->闪光（拉丁fulgere），refulgent->极其闪耀的=灿烂的（cf. fulgent闪耀，effulgent光辉灿烂，cf. fulcrum支点） || 文化联想：晨光照在故宫琉璃瓦上闪耀的景象最适合帮助记忆 refulgent，可以说 **refulgent light — “Morning sun can cast refulgent light across the glazed roofs of the Forbidden City.”**

quiz.question: effulgent _____
quiz.explanation: 光辉灿烂的, 光辉灿烂的光. The sunrise cast effulgent light across the sky. 日出在天空中投射出光辉灿烂的光。 | ef->向外，fulg->闪光，effulgent->向外射出光芒的=光辉灿烂的（cf. refulgent灿烂，fulgent闪耀，fulgurite闪电石） || 文化联想：夜晚宫灯和金色装饰光华四射的画面最适合帮助记忆 effulgent，可以说 **effulgent light — “During a lantern festival, an ornate pavilion may seem wrapped in effulgent light.”**

quiz.question: plangent ____
quiz.explanation: 响亮的; 悲鸣的, 响亮的音调. The bell rang with a plangent tone. 钟声以响亮的音调响起。 | plang->打击/哭泣（拉丁plangere），plangent->撞击出的响亮悲鸣（cf. complain抱怨=大声哭诉，plaint哀诉，plaintiff原告） || 文化联想：二胡哀婉而有穿透力的声音最适合帮助记忆 plangent，可以说 **a plangent tone — “An erhu solo can take on a plangent tone that sounds both resonant and sorrowful.”**

quiz.question: stringent _____
quiz.explanation: 严格的; 严厉的, 严格的规则. The company enforces stringent rules for safety. 公司执行严格的安全规则。 | string->绑紧（拉丁stringere），stringent->绑得很紧的=严格的（cf. astringent收敛，constrict收缩，restrict限制） || 文化联想：高考考场严格的纪律最适合帮助记忆 stringent，可以说 **stringent rules — “A major national examination operates under stringent rules designed to protect fairness and security.”**

quiz.question: astringent _____
quiz.explanation: 收敛的; 涩的, 收敛性化妆水. Use an astringent toner to minimize pores. 使用收敛性化妆水来缩小毛孔。 | ad->朝向，string->绑紧，astringent->朝里绑紧=收敛的（cf. stringent严格，constrict收缩，restrict限制） || 文化联想：喝一口浓茶后嘴里发涩的感觉最适合帮助记忆 astringent，可以说 **an astringent taste — “Strongly brewed tea can leave an astringent taste that makes the mouth feel dry and puckered.”**

quiz.question: contingent _________
quiz.explanation: 可能发生的; 依情况而定的, 或有负债. The company disclosed contingent liability in its report. 公司在报告中披露了或有负债。 | con->共同，ting->触摸（拉丁tangere），contingent->共同接触=有可能接触到的=依情而定的（cf. contagious传染，tangible可触，contact接触） || 文化联想：中国企业财报里担保责任等“或有负债”最适合帮助记忆 contingent，可以说 **a contingent liability — “A company guarantee may create a contingent liability that becomes real only if a specified event occurs.”**

quiz.question: pungent _____
quiz.explanation: 刺激的; 辛辣的, 刺鼻的气味. The cheese has a pungent smell that is quite strong. 奶酪有一种相当浓烈的刺鼻气味。 | pung->刺（拉丁pungere），pungent->像针刺一样刺激的（cf. puncture刺穿，compunction内疚，poignant辛酸，expunge删除） || 文化联想：臭豆腐强烈的气味最适合帮助记忆 pungent，可以说 **a pungent smell — “Freshly fried stinky tofu can have a pungent smell that reaches people long before they reach the stall.”**

quiz.question: cogent ________
quiz.explanation: 有说服力的; 令人信服的, 有说服力的论点. The lawyer presented a cogent argument to the jury. 律师向陪审团提出了有说服力的论点。 | cog->驱动（拉丁cogere->强迫），cogent->强迫人信服的=有说服力的（cf. cogitate思考，coerce强迫，incognito匿名） || 文化联想：中文“有理有据、让人信服”最适合帮助记忆 cogent，可以说 **a cogent argument — “An explanation supported by clear evidence and sound logic can become a cogent argument.”**

quiz.question: divergent _____
quiz.explanation: 分歧的; 不同的, 分歧的观点. The committee members held divergent views on the issue. 委员会成员对这个问题持有分歧的观点。 | di->分开，verg->转向（拉丁vergere），divergent->朝两个方向转=分歧的（cf. converge汇聚，verge边缘，subvert颠覆） || 文化联想：中文“各有各的看法、意见分叉”最适合帮助记忆 divergent，可以说 **divergent views — “A family discussing whether to sell an old house may develop divergent views about money, memory, and practicality.”**

quiz.question: convergent _________
quiz.explanation: 趋同的; 会聚的, 趋同进化. Scientists study convergent evolution in different species. 科学家研究不同物种的趋同进化。 | con->共同，verg->转向，convergent->朝同一方向转=趋同的（cf. divergent分歧，verge接近，subvert颠覆） || 文化联想：中国生物课学习不同生物独立演化出相似特征最适合帮助记忆 convergent，可以说 **convergent evolution — “A biology student may learn that similar environmental pressures can produce convergent evolution in unrelated species.”**

quiz.question: insurgent ______
quiz.explanation: 叛乱的; 起义者, 叛乱军队. The insurgent forces attacked the capital. 叛乱军队攻击了首都。 | in->向上，surg->升起（拉丁surgere），insurgent->起身反抗的=叛乱的（cf. surge涌现，insurrection叛乱，resurrect复活） || 文化联想：insurgent 是军事政治语境里的“叛乱武装”，可用中国学生学习世界近现代史来记忆，可以说 **insurgent forces — “In a modern-history course, students may read about insurgent forces fighting a central government.”**

quiz.question: ______ proficient
quiz.explanation: 熟练的; 精通的, 非常熟练的. She is highly proficient in three languages. 她精通三种语言。 | pro->向前，fic->做（拉丁），proficient->向前做到位=熟练的（cf. efficient有效，sufficient足够，deficient不足，proficiency熟练） || 文化联想：中文“熟能生巧、做得很在行”最适合帮助记忆 proficient，可以说 **proficient in calligraphy — “Years of disciplined brush practice can make a student proficient in calligraphy.”**

quiz.question: omniscient ________
quiz.explanation: 全知的, 全知叙述者. The novel uses an omniscient narrator perspective. 小说使用全知叙述者视角。 | omni->全部，sci->知道（拉丁scire），omniscient->知道一切的=全知的（cf. science科学，conscience良心，conscious有意识的） || 文化联想：中国章回小说里作者知道所有人物心事的叙事方式最适合帮助记忆 omniscient，可以说 **an omniscient narrator — “A traditional-style novel may use an omniscient narrator who can reveal what several characters are thinking at once.”**

quiz.question: ___________ expedient
quiz.explanation: 权宜的; 方便的, 政治上权宜的. The decision was politically expedient but morally wrong. 这个决定在政治上是权宜之计,但在道德上是错误的。 | ex->向外，ped->脚，expedient->解放脚=方便/权宜的（cf. expedite加快，impede阻碍，pedestrian行人，expedition探险） || 文化联想：中文“权宜之计”最适合帮助记忆 expedient，可以说 **a politically expedient compromise — “A leader may accept a politically expedient compromise because it solves an immediate problem, even if it is not ideal.”**

quiz.question: inexpedient ____
quiz.explanation: 不适宜的; 不明智的, 不明智的举动. Raising taxes now would be an inexpedient move. 现在增税将是不明智的举动。 | in->否定，expedient->权宜的，inexpedient->不权宜/不明智的（cf. expedient权宜，expedite加快，impede阻碍） || 文化联想：中文“这么做不合时宜、得不偿失”最适合帮助记忆 inexpedient，可以说 **an inexpedient move — “Raising prices sharply during a public-relations crisis would be an inexpedient move.”**

quiz.question: ______ ingredient
quiz.explanation: 成分; 要素, 活性成分. The active ingredient treats the infection effectively. 活性成分有效治疗感染。 | in->进入，gredi->走（拉丁），ingredient->走进去的东西=成分（cf. progress进步，congress会议，degrade降级，grade等级） || 文化联想：中国火锅里每一样食材都是 ingredient，可以说 **a hotpot ingredient — “Lotus root, tofu, mushrooms, and sliced meat can each be a hotpot ingredient.”**

quiz.question: salient _______
quiz.explanation: 显著的; 突出的, 显著特征. The report highlights the salient feature of the proposal. 报告强调了提案的显著特征。 | sali->跳（拉丁salire），salient->跳出来的=显著的（cf. sally突击，result结果，exult欢跳，somersault翻筋斗） || 文化联想：中文“最突出的重点、一眼就跳出来”最适合帮助记忆 salient，可以说 **a salient feature — “The most salient feature of a traditional courtyard house may be the central open courtyard around which the rooms are arranged.”**

quiz.question: resilient _______
quiz.explanation: 有弹性的; 有韧性的, 有韧性的经济. The resilient economy recovered quickly from the crisis. 有韧性的经济从危机中迅速恢复。 | re->回，sili->跳，resilient->跳回来的=有弹性的（cf. salient显著，exult欢跳，insult侮辱=跳到脸上，result结果） || 文化联想：中文“百折不挠、受打击后还能弹回来”最适合帮助记忆 resilient，可以说 **a resilient economy — “An economy that recovers quickly after a severe shock can be described as resilient—很像‘百折不挠.’”**

quiz.question: ____ emollient
quiz.explanation: 润肤的; 缓和的, 皮肤润肤剂. Apply skin emollient to dry areas daily. 每天在干燥区域涂抹皮肤润肤剂。 | e->使，moll->软（拉丁mollis），emollient->使皮肤软化的=润肤的（cf. mollify安抚，mollusk软体动物，molten熔融） || 文化联想：北京冬天空气干燥时常用润肤霜最适合帮助记忆 emollient，可以说 **an emollient cream — “In a dry northern winter, an emollient cream can help soften and protect cracked skin.”**

quiz.question: lenient ________
quiz.explanation: 宽大的; 仁慈的, 宽大的判决. The judge gave a lenient sentence to the first offender. 法官对初犯给予了宽大的判决。 | len->柔和（拉丁lenis->温和），lenient->温和宽容的（cf. relent软化，relentless不停息，lenity宽大） || 文化联想：中文法律语境里的“从轻判决”最适合帮助记忆 lenient，可以说 **a lenient sentence — “A judge may impose a lenient sentence on a first-time offender when the law and circumstances justify mercy.”**

quiz.question: sapient ______
quiz.explanation: 智慧的; 聪明的, 明智的选择. Hiring her proved to be a sapient choice. 雇用她被证明是明智的选择。 | sap->尝味/品鉴（拉丁sapere->品尝/智慧），sapient->有智慧的（cf. Homo sapiens智人，savor品味，savant学者，sage智者） || 文化联想：中文“三思而后行”最适合帮助记忆 sapient，可以说 **a sapient choice — “Choosing the safer long-term option after carefully weighing the evidence can be a sapient choice.”**

quiz.question: ___ recipient
quiz.explanation: 接受者; 受益人, 援助接受者. The aid recipient thanked the donors for their generosity. 援助接受者感谢捐赠者的慷慨。 | re->回，cip->抓取（拉丁capere），recipient->接过来的人=接受者（cf. receive接收，perceive感知，reception接待） || 文化联想：中国奖学金获得者最适合帮助记忆 recipient，可以说 **a scholarship recipient — “A scholarship recipient may use the award to cover tuition, books, and living expenses.”**

quiz.question: incipient _____
quiz.explanation: 初期的; 开始的, 初期阶段. The disease was caught at an incipient stage. 疾病在初期阶段被发现。 | in->进入，cip->抓取/开始，incipient->刚开始抓住的=初期的（cf. inception开始，receive接收，concept概念） || 文化联想：中文“防微杜渐、在苗头刚出现时就处理”最适合帮助记忆 incipient，可以说 **an incipient problem — “Fixing an incipient problem before it spreads is often easier than waiting until the damage becomes obvious.”**

quiz.question: oriental ___
quiz.explanation: 东方的, 东方地毯. The oriental rug added elegance to the room. 东方地毯为房间增添了优雅。 | orient->东方（拉丁oriens->日出的方向），oriental->东方的（cf. orient方向，orientation定向，disoriented迷失方向） || 文化联想：oriental 更适合用于物品或传统分类而不宜用来称呼人，可用中国学生学习英语用法时记忆，可以说 **an oriental rug — “An English learner may encounter the traditional term oriental rug for certain carpets while avoiding oriental as a label for people.”**

quiz.question: nutrient ______
quiz.explanation: 营养物; 营养的, 营养摄入. Monitor your daily nutrient intake for better health. 监测你的每日营养摄入以获得更好的健康。 | nutri->滋养（拉丁nutrire），nutrient->提供滋养的物质（cf. nutrition营养，nurse护士，nourish滋养） || 文化联想：中国家庭讲究荤素搭配来保证营养摄入，最适合帮助记忆 nutrient，可以说 **nutrient intake — “A balanced meal with vegetables, grains, protein, and fruit can improve daily nutrient intake.”**

quiz.question: transient _____
quiz.explanation: 短暂的; 临时的, 临时客人. The hotel caters to transient guest passing through. 酒店为路过的临时客人提供服务。 | trans->穿越，ient->走，transient->穿越而过的=短暂的（cf. transit过境，transcend超越，transitory短暂的） || 文化联想：中文“只是匆匆过客”最适合帮助记忆 transient，可以说 **a transient visitor — “A traveler who stays in a city for only one night is a transient visitor rather than a long-term resident.”**

quiz.question: sentient _____
quiz.explanation: 有感觉的; 有知觉的, 有知觉的生命. All sentient being deserve compassion and respect. 所有有知觉的生命都值得同情和尊重。 | sent->感觉（拉丁sentire），sentient->有感觉能力的（cf. sense感觉，sensitive敏感，sentiment情感，consent同意） || 文化联想：佛教里“有情众生”的说法最适合帮助记忆 sentient，可以说 **sentient beings — “In Buddhist vocabulary, ‘有情众生’ is often translated as sentient beings capable of feeling and experience.”**

quiz.question: insentient ______
quiz.explanation: 无感觉的; 无生命的, 无生命的物质. Rocks are insentient matter without consciousness. 岩石是无意识的无生命物质。 | in->否定，sentient->有感觉的，insentient->无感觉的（cf. sentient有知觉，sensory感觉的，insensible无感觉） || 文化联想：中文“无知觉的石头”最适合帮助记忆 insentient，可以说 **insentient matter — “A stone may be described as insentient matter because it has no capacity for sensation or awareness.”**

quiz.question: ambivalent ________
quiz.explanation: 矛盾的; 模棱两可的, 矛盾的态度. She has an ambivalent attitude toward the proposal. 她对这个提案持有矛盾的态度。 | ambi->两者，val->力量/价值，ambivalent->对两者都有感情=矛盾的（cf. ambiguous模棱两可，ambidextrous两手灵，valor勇气） || 文化联想：中文“既期待又担心、心里很矛盾”最适合帮助记忆 ambivalent，可以说 **an ambivalent attitude — “A family moving to a new city may have an ambivalent attitude, excited by new opportunities but sad to leave familiar surroundings.”**

quiz.question: ____________ equivalent
quiz.explanation: 等价的; 相等的, 数学等式. The two expressions are mathematical equivalent. 这两个表达式在数学上是等价的。 | equ->相等，val->价值，equivalent->价值相等的（cf. equal平等，equate等同，equity公平，equinox春秋分） || 文化联想：中国中学数学里把两个式子化成等价形式最适合帮助记忆 equivalent，可以说 **an equivalent expression — “A student may simplify an equation and replace one expression with an equivalent expression that has the same value.”**

quiz.question: pestilent _______
quiz.explanation: 瘟疫的; 有害的, 瘟疫性疾病. The pestilent disease spread rapidly through the city. 瘟疫性疾病在城市中迅速传播。 | pest->瘟疫（拉丁pestis），pestilent->像瘟疫一样有害的（cf. pest害虫，pesticide杀虫剂，pestilence瘟疫） || 文化联想：中国历史课讨论古代瘟疫时最适合帮助记忆 pestilent，可以说 **a pestilent disease — “In a historical account, a pestilent disease may spread rapidly through crowded towns with little effective treatment.”**

quiz.question: repellent ____
quiz.explanation: 令人厌恶的; 防护的, 令人厌恶的气味. The garbage gave off a repellent odor. 垃圾散发出令人厌恶的气味。 | re->回，pell->推（拉丁pellere），repellent->推开的=令人厌恶的（cf. propel推进，expel驱逐，compel强迫，impel推动） || 文化联想：夏天垃圾桶散发让人避之不及的气味最适合帮助记忆 repellent，可以说 **a repellent odor — “Food waste left in summer heat can produce a repellent odor that makes people step away immediately.”**

quiz.question: redolent __ _____
quiz.explanation: 芳香的; 使人想起的, 散发玫瑰香气. The garden air was redolent of roses in bloom. 花园的空气散发着盛开玫瑰的香气。 | re->回，dol->气味（拉丁olere->散发气味），redolent->回散着气味的=芳香的（cf. odor气味，deodorant除臭剂，olfaction嗅觉） || 文化联想：桂花季满院都是香气最适合帮助记忆 redolent，可以说 **redolent of osmanthus — “An autumn courtyard in Hangzhou may be redolent of osmanthus when the tiny flowers are in bloom.”**

quiz.question: indolent _________
quiz.explanation: 懒惰的; 无痛的, 懒散的生活方式. His indolent lifestyle led to health problems. 他懒散的生活方式导致了健康问题。 | in->否定，dol->痛苦（拉丁dolere），indolent->不感到痛苦的=慵懒无痛的（cf. condolences哀悼，dolor痛苦，doleful悲哀） || 文化联想：中文“好吃懒做”最适合帮助记忆 indolent，可以说 **an indolent lifestyle — “Someone who avoids work, exercise, and responsibility may fall into an indolent lifestyle.”**

quiz.question: somnolent _____
quiz.explanation: 困倦的; 催眠的, 困倦状态. The medication left him in a somnolent state. 药物使他处于困倦状态。 | somn->睡眠（拉丁somnus），somnolent->充满睡意的（cf. somnambulism梦游，insomnia失眠，dormitory宿舍） || 文化联想：中文“午饭后昏昏欲睡”最适合帮助记忆 somnolent，可以说 **a somnolent state — “After a heavy lunch on a warm afternoon, an office worker may slip into a somnolent state.”**

quiz.question: benevolent ______
quiz.explanation: 仁慈的; 善意的, 仁慈的领导者. The benevolent leader cared deeply for his people. 仁慈的领导者深切关心他的人民。 | bene->好，vol->意愿（拉丁velle），benevolent->有好意愿的=仁慈的（cf. volunteer自愿者，malevolent恶意，volition意志） || 文化联想：孟子所说的“仁政”可以帮助记忆 benevolent，可以说 **a benevolent ruler — “In traditional political thought, a benevolent ruler is expected to care about the welfare of ordinary people.”**

quiz.question: turbulent _____
quiz.explanation: 动荡的; 骚乱的, 动荡的时期. The nation survived turbulent times of war and upheaval. 国家在战争和动荡的动荡时期幸存下来。 | turb->搅乱（拉丁turbare），turbulent->搅乱的=动荡的（cf. disturb打扰，perturb使不安，turbine涡轮=被搅动） || 文化联想：中文“风云动荡的年代”最适合帮助记忆 turbulent，可以说 **turbulent times — “A family memoir may describe turbulent times marked by war, migration, and rapid political change.”**

quiz.question: truculent ____
quiz.explanation: 好斗的; 残暴的, 好斗的语气. His truculent tone escalated the disagreement. 他好斗的语气使分歧升级。 | truc->凶残（拉丁trux->凶猛），truculent->凶残好斗的（cf. truculent vs. pugnacious两者都是好斗，truculent更残暴） || 文化联想：中文“横眉冷对、语气蛮横好斗”最适合帮助记忆 truculent，可以说 **a truculent tone — “A speaker who answers every question with hostility may adopt a truculent tone that makes discussion difficult.”**

quiz.question: fraudulent ______
quiz.explanation: 欺诈的; 欺骗性的, 欺诈计划. Investigators uncovered a fraudulent scheme to steal money. 调查人员揭露了一个欺诈计划来窃取金钱。 | fraud->欺骗（拉丁fraus），fraudulent->充满欺骗的（cf. fraud欺诈，defraud诈骗，fraudster诈骗犯） || 文化联想：中国常见的电信诈骗最适合帮助记忆 fraudulent，可以说 **a fraudulent scheme — “A caller pretending to be a police officer and demanding an urgent transfer may be running a fraudulent scheme.”**

quiz.question: opulent _______
quiz.explanation: 富裕的; 豪华的, 豪华的豪宅. The billionaire lived in an opulent mansion. 亿万富翁住在豪华的豪宅里。 | op->财富（拉丁opes->财富），opulent->拥有大量财富的=豪华的（cf. opulence富裕，inoperable无法操作，operation操作） || 文化联想：晋商大院里豪华宽阔的宅邸最适合帮助记忆 opulent，可以说 **an opulent mansion — “A wealthy merchant family in an old historical drama may live in an opulent mansion with carved wood, courtyards, and elaborate furnishings.”**

quiz.question: corpulent ____
quiz.explanation: 肥胖的, 肥胖的身体. His corpulent body made movement difficult. 他肥胖的身体使行动困难。 | corp->身体（拉丁corpus），corpulent->身体过于庞大的=肥胖的（cf. corpus文集，corpse尸体，incorporate并入，corporal肉体的） || 文化联想：古典小说里常把富商写成身材肥胖的人物，最适合帮助记忆 corpulent，可以说 **a corpulent merchant — “An old-fashioned novel may portray a prosperous, corpulent merchant seated comfortably behind a shop counter.”**

quiz.question: virulent ______
quiz.explanation: 剧毒的; 恶毒的, 剧毒的病毒株. Scientists study the virulent strain of the disease. 科学家研究该疾病的剧毒病毒株。 | vir->毒（拉丁virus），virulent->毒性强烈的（cf. virus病毒，virtual实际上，virtue美德=力量，virile男性的） || 文化联想：中国医院传染病科讨论毒力很强的病原株最适合帮助记忆 virulent，可以说 **a virulent strain — “Doctors may worry when a virulent strain causes more severe disease and spreads rapidly.”**

quiz.question: __ _ predicament
quiz.explanation: 困境; 窘境, 处于困境. She found herself in a predicament with no easy solution. 她发现自己处于没有简单解决方案的困境中。 | predic->宣告（拉丁praedicare），predicament->被宣判的处境=困境（cf. predict预言，predicate谓语，preach布道） || 文化联想：中文“进退两难”最适合帮助记忆 predicament，可以说 **be in a predicament — “A family that must choose between an unaffordable repair and an expensive move may be in a predicament—真正‘进退两难.’”**

quiz.question: ____ filament
quiz.explanation: 细丝; 灯丝, 细丝. The spider spun a fine filament web. 蜘蛛编织了一张细丝网。 | filum->线（拉丁），filament->极细的线=细丝/灯丝（cf. file文件=线状排列，profile轮廓线，filiform线状） || 文化联想：中国3D打印机把一卷细丝送进喷头最适合帮助记忆 filament，可以说 **a plastic filament — “A desktop 3D printer feeds a plastic filament into a heated nozzle to build an object layer by layer.”**

quiz.question: ______ tournament
quiz.explanation: 锦标赛; 联赛, 网球锦标赛. She competed in the tennis tournament last weekend. 她上周末参加了网球锦标赛。 | tourner->转（法语），tournament->骑士绕圈比武=锦标赛（cf. tour旅游，tourniquet止血带，detour绕道，contour轮廓） || 文化联想：中国乒乓球比赛最适合帮助记忆 tournament，可以说 **a table-tennis tournament — “Young athletes from several provinces may compete in a national table-tennis tournament.”**

quiz.question: ____ sacrament
quiz.explanation: 圣礼; 圣事, 神圣的圣礼. The priest administered the holy sacrament. 牧师主持了神圣的圣礼。 | sacr->神圣（拉丁sacer），sacrament->神圣的仪式=圣礼（cf. sacred神圣，sacrifice牺牲，sacrilege渎神，consecrate奉献） || 文化联想：sacrament 是基督教“圣礼”，可用中国教堂礼拜场景来记忆，可以说 **a holy sacrament — “In a Christian church in China, believers may participate in a holy sacrament according to their denomination’s tradition.”**

quiz.question: _____testament
quiz.explanation: 遗嘱; 证明, 最后遗嘱. He left his last will and testament with his lawyer. 他把最后遗嘱留给了律师。 | test->见证（拉丁testis->证人），testament->见证文件=遗嘱（cf. testify作证，attest证明，protest抗议，testimony证词） || 文化联想：中国家庭订立遗嘱、把房产和存款交代清楚的场景最适合帮助记忆 testament，可以说 **a last will and testament — “An elderly parent may prepare a last will and testament to specify how property and savings should be distributed.”**

quiz.question: ______________ amendment
quiz.explanation: 修正案; 修改, 宪法修正案. The constitutional amendment was ratified by all states. 宪法修正案被所有州批准。 | amend->改善（拉丁emendare->去除错误），amendment->改善的行为=修正案（cf. mend修缮，emend修订，amenity舒适） || 文化联想：中国宪法修正案的正式法律文本最适合帮助记忆 amendment，可以说 **a constitutional amendment — “A constitutional amendment formally changes part of a country’s constitution through the required legal process.”**

quiz.question: _________ bombardment
quiz.explanation: 炮击; 轰炸, 炮兵轰炸. The city endured heavy artillery bombardment. 这座城市遭受了猛烈的炮兵轰炸。 | bombard->用炸弹攻击（法语bombe->炸弹），bombardment->轰炸（cf. bomb炸弹，bombshell爆炸新闻，bombastic夸大的） || 文化联想：近代战争史里城市遭受炮火轰击的画面最适合帮助记忆 bombardment，可以说 **heavy bombardment — “A city under heavy bombardment may suffer repeated artillery fire for hours or days.”**

quiz.question: cement ____
quiz.explanation: 水泥; 巩固, 水泥墙. Workers built a strong cement wall around the property. 工人们在房产周围建了一堵坚固的水泥墙。 | caementum->砖石（拉丁，来自caedere->切），cement->切石制成的粉末=水泥（cf. cemetery墓地=安眠之处，cenotaph纪念碑） || 文化联想：中国建筑工地砌围墙最适合帮助记忆 cement，可以说 **a cement wall — “Workers may build a cement wall around a construction site to create a durable boundary.”**

quiz.question: _______ commencement
quiz.explanation: 开始; 毕业典礼, 大学毕业典礼. She graduated at the college commencement ceremony. 她在大学毕业典礼上毕业。 | com->共同，menc->开始（拉丁），commencement->共同开始=毕业典礼（新生活的开始，cf. commence开始，initiates入门） || 文化联想：中国大学毕业典礼是 commencement 最直观的现代场景，可以说 **a college commencement — “Graduates may wear gowns and receive diplomas during a college commencement ceremony.”**

quiz.question: ______ derangement
quiz.explanation: 错乱; 精神失常, 精神错乱. The doctor diagnosed mental derangement in the patient. 医生诊断患者有精神错乱。 | de->去除，range->排列（法语），derangement->打乱了排列=错乱（cf. arrange安排，range范围，derange使失常） || 文化联想：中文“精神错乱、思路完全乱套”最适合帮助记忆 derangement，可以说 **mental derangement — “Severe illness or trauma can sometimes cause mental derangement that disrupts normal thought and behavior.”**

quiz.question: _____ rapprochement
quiz.explanation: 和解; 友好关系的恢复, 和平和解. The nations worked toward peace rapprochement. 各国努力实现和平和解。 | rapprocher->使接近（法语，re+approcher），rapprochement->重新接近=和解（注意t不发音，cf. approach接近，reproach责备） || 文化联想：中文“破冰和解、关系回暖”最适合帮助记忆 rapprochement，可以说 **a diplomatic rapprochement — “Two countries that resume talks and restore cooperation may move toward a diplomatic rapprochement.”**

quiz.question: clement _______
quiz.explanation: 温和的; 仁慈的, 温和的天气. The clement weather made outdoor activities pleasant. 温和的天气使户外活动愉快。 | clemens->温和（拉丁），clement->温和仁慈的（cf. clemency宽恕，inclement恶劣，Clement人名=温和者） || 文化联想：江南春日温和宜人的天气最适合帮助记忆 clement，可以说 **clement weather — “Clement weather in spring can make a walk beside West Lake especially pleasant.”**

quiz.question: inclement _______
quiz.explanation: 恶劣的; 严酷的, 恶劣的天气. The inclement weather forced cancellation of the event. 恶劣的天气迫使活动取消。 | in->否定，clement->温和，inclement->不温和的=严酷的（cf. clement温和，clemency宽恕，cf. clement vs. inclement天气一对反义词） || 文化联想：中文“恶劣天气导致活动取消”最适合帮助记忆 inclement，可以说 **inclement weather — “A school sports day may be postponed because of inclement weather and heavy rain.”**

quiz.question: ______ befuddlement
quiz.explanation: 困惑; 迷惑, 精神困惑. His mental befuddlement made decision-making difficult. 他的精神困惑使决策变得困难。 | befuddle->使迷糊（be+fuddle->喝醉），befuddlement->迷糊困惑的状态（cf. muddle混乱，fuddled喝醉的，puzzle困惑） || 文化联想：中文“一头雾水”最适合帮助记忆 befuddlement，可以说 **complete befuddlement — “A student facing contradictory instructions may stare at the page in complete befuddlement.”**

quiz.question: _____ supplement
quiz.explanation: 补充; 增补, 每日补充剂. She takes a daily supplement of vitamins. 她每天服用维生素补充剂。 | sup->从下，ple->填满（拉丁plere），supplement->从下面填满不足=补充（cf. supply供应，complete完成，implement实施，replenish补充） || 文化联想：中国家庭每天吃维生素或营养补充剂最适合帮助记忆 supplement，可以说 **a daily supplement — “Someone may take a daily supplement after discussing nutritional needs with a doctor or dietitian.”**

quiz.question: ______ embezzlement
quiz.explanation: 挪用; 盗用, 犯挪用罪. The accountant was arrested for commit embezzlement. 会计因犯挪用罪被捕。 | embezzle->挪用（古法语besillier->毁坏），embezzlement->挪用公款（cf. besiege围攻，embezzler挪用者，misappropriate挪用） || 文化联想：中文“挪用公款”最适合帮助记忆 embezzlement，可以说 **commit embezzlement — “An accountant who secretly transfers company funds into a personal account may commit embezzlement.”**

quiz.question: ______ increment
quiz.explanation: 增量; 增加, 年度增量. Employees receive an annual increment based on performance. 员工根据表现获得年度增量。 | in->进入，cre->增长（拉丁crescere），increment->增加的量（cf. crescent月牙，increase增加，decrease减少，recruit招募） || 文化联想：中国公司每年调薪时增加一小档工资最适合帮助记忆 increment，可以说 **an annual increment — “An employee may receive an annual increment after a strong performance review.”**

quiz.question: ______ procurement
quiz.explanation: 采购; 获得, 公共采购. The government follows strict public procurement rules. 政府遵循严格的公共采购规则。 | pro->为了，cur->照料（拉丁curare），procurement->为了某人照料获取=采购（cf. procure获取，cure治疗，curator馆长，accurate精确） || 文化联想：中国政府和大型企业的公开招标采购最适合帮助记忆 procurement，可以说 **public procurement — “Public procurement rules can require agencies to use transparent bidding when purchasing goods and services.”**

quiz.question: self-abasement ______
quiz.explanation: 自我贬低, 自我贬低仪式. The cult practiced a self-abasement ritual. 该教派实行自我贬低仪式。 | abase->贬低（a+base->使成为基础=降低），self-abasement->自我贬低（cf. debase使贬值，base基础/卑鄙，abasement贬低） || 文化联想：中文“妄自菲薄、自我贬低”最适合帮助记忆 self-abasement，可以说 **an act of self-abasement — “Constantly describing oneself as worthless in order to please others can become an unhealthy act of self-abasement.”**

quiz.question: ________ denouement
quiz.explanation: 结局; 收场, 戏剧性结局. The play features a dramatic denouement in the final act. 该剧在最后一幕有戏剧性结局。 | dénouer->解开（法语，de+nouer->解结），denouement->解开情节的结尾=结局（注意t不发音，cf. knot结，annul废除） || 文化联想：中文“尘埃落定、故事收场”最适合帮助记忆 denouement，可以说 **the final denouement — “After every secret is revealed and every conflict is resolved, the novel reaches its final denouement.”**

quiz.question: _______ fragment
quiz.explanation: 碎片; 片段, 陶器碎片. Archaeologists found a pottery fragment at the site. 考古学家在遗址发现了陶器碎片。 | frag->破碎（拉丁frangere），fragment->破碎的片段（cf. fracture骨折，fraction分数，refract折射，fragile易碎） || 文化联想：中国考古遗址里出土的一小块陶片最适合帮助记忆 fragment，可以说 **a pottery fragment — “An archaeologist may identify a pottery fragment by studying its clay, glaze, and decorative pattern.”**

quiz.question: ____ pigment
quiz.explanation: 色素; 颜料, 皮肤色素. Melanin is the skin pigment that determines color. 黑色素是决定肤色的皮肤色素。 | ping->绘制/颜色（拉丁pingere），pigment->用来涂色的物质=色素（cf. paint绘画，picture图画，depict描绘，pigmentation色素沉淀） || 文化联想：中国山水画和壁画使用天然矿物颜料最适合帮助记忆 pigment，可以说 **a mineral pigment — “Traditional painters may grind a mineral pigment to produce a durable blue, green, or red color.”**

quiz.question: augment ________
quiz.explanation: 增加; 扩大, 增加容量. The company plans to augment capacity by 50 percent. 公司计划将容量增加50%。 | aug->增加（拉丁augere），augment->使增加（cf. August八月=奥古斯都大帝=威严增长者，augur占卜，inauguration就职） || 文化联想：中文“扩大产能”最适合帮助记忆 augment，可以说 **augment capacity — “A factory may install a new production line to augment capacity before demand rises.”**

quiz.question: ______ retrenchment
quiz.explanation: 紧缩; 削减, 预算紧缩. The recession forced budget retrenchment across departments. 经济衰退迫使各部门预算紧缩。 | re->回，trench->挖（法语trancher->切），retrenchment->削减回去=紧缩（cf. trench战壕，entrench巩固，trenchant尖锐） || 文化联想：中文“勒紧裤腰带、削减预算”最适合帮助记忆 retrenchment，可以说 **budget retrenchment — “A company facing a recession may begin budget retrenchment by cutting travel, hiring, and discretionary spending.”**

quiz.question: _____ blandishment
quiz.explanation: 奉承; 甜言蜜语, 甜蜜的奉承. She resisted his sweet blandishment and flattery. 她抵制了他甜蜜的奉承和恭维。 | bland->温和/乏味，blandish->奉承，blandishment->甜言蜜语（cf. bland乏味，blanch使变白，blasé漠然的） || 文化联想：中文“甜言蜜语、好话笼络”最适合帮助记忆 blandishment，可以说 **sweet blandishment — “A savvy buyer may ignore sweet blandishment from a salesperson and focus on the actual contract terms.”**

quiz.question: ______ impediment
quiz.explanation: 障碍; 妨碍, 语言障碍. He overcame a childhood speech impediment. 他克服了儿童时期的语言障碍。 | im->进入，ped->脚（拉丁pes），impediment->把脚绊住=障碍（cf. impede阻碍，expedite加快=解放脚，pedestrian行人） || 文化联想：中文“口吃或发音障碍”最适合帮助记忆 impediment，可以说 **a speech impediment — “A child with a speech impediment may work with a specialist to improve pronunciation and fluency.”**

quiz.question: _____ sediment
quiz.explanation: 沉积物, 河流沉积物. River sediment accumulated at the delta over centuries. 河流沉积物在三角洲积累了几个世纪。 | sed->坐/沉（拉丁sedere），sediment->沉下去的东西=沉积物（cf. sedentary久坐，reside居住，preside主持，session会议） || 文化联想：黄河和长江携带泥沙沉积的场景最适合帮助记忆 sediment，可以说 **river sediment — “River sediment can accumulate over time and gradually reshape a delta or riverbank.”**

quiz.question: _____ condiment
quiz.explanation: 调味品, 辛辣调味品. The restaurant offers various spicy condiment options. 餐厅提供各种辛辣调味品选择。 | con->共同，diment->调制（拉丁condire->调味），condiment->用来调味的东西（cf. condition条件，condone纵容） || 文化联想：中国餐桌上的辣椒酱、醋和酱油最适合帮助记忆 condiment，可以说 **a spicy condiment — “Chili oil can serve as a spicy condiment that diners add to noodles, dumplings, or cold dishes.”**

quiz.question: embodiment __ _______
quiz.explanation: 体现; 化身, 勇气的化身. The soldier was the embodiment of courage. 这位士兵是勇气的化身。 | embody->使具体化（em+body），embodiment->抽象概念的具体化=化身（cf. body身体，incorporate并入，personify拟人化） || 文化联想：岳飞等忠勇人物常被塑造成“勇气的化身”，最适合帮助记忆 embodiment，可以说 **the embodiment of courage — “A historical hero who remains brave under extreme pressure may be remembered as the embodiment of courage.”**

quiz.question: ____ regiment
quiz.explanation: 团; 军团, 陆军团. The army regiment was deployed to the border. 陆军团被部署到边境。 | regimen->统治（拉丁regere），regiment->统治/管理一组人=军团（cf. regime政权，region地区，regular规则的，regal皇家的） || 文化联想：中国近现代军事史里的步兵团最适合帮助记忆 regiment，可以说 **an army regiment — “An army regiment may contain several battalions under a single command structure.”**

quiz.question: ___ _ compliment
quiz.explanation: 赞美; 称赞, 给予赞美. He stopped to pay a compliment on her work. 他停下来对她的工作给予赞美。 | com->共同，pli->折叠/礼貌（拉丁），compliment->礼貌地折叠表示=赞美（注意与complement补充区分，cf. comply遵从） || 文化联想：中文“真心夸一句”最适合帮助记忆 compliment，可以说 **pay a compliment — “A colleague may pay a compliment after seeing a presentation that is unusually clear and well designed.”**

quiz.question: ______ sentiment
quiz.explanation: 情感; 观点, 公众情绪. Public sentiment shifted against the policy. 公众情绪转而反对该政策。 | sent->感觉（拉丁sentire），sentiment->内心的感觉=情感/情绪（cf. sense感觉，sensitive敏感，sentence判决，assent同意） || 文化联想：中文“社会舆论风向”最适合帮助记忆 sentiment，可以说 **public sentiment — “Public sentiment may change quickly after new evidence about a controversial policy becomes available.”**

quiz.question: ____ presentiment
quiz.explanation: 预感, 不祥的预感. She had a dark presentiment about the journey. 她对这次旅行有不祥的预感。 | pre->提前，sentiment->感觉，presentiment->提前感觉到的=预感（cf. sentiment情感，sense感觉，premonition预兆） || 文化联想：中文“心里有种不祥预感”最适合帮助记忆 presentiment，可以说 **a dark presentiment — “Before setting out in dangerous weather, a traveler may feel a dark presentiment that something will go wrong.”**

quiz.question: _____ embankment
quiz.explanation: 堤岸; 路堤, 河堤. The river embankment prevents flooding in the city. 河堤防止城市洪水。 | em->使，bank->堤岸，embankment->建造堤岸的工程=堤（cf. bank银行/河岸，riverbank河岸，dyke堤坝） || 文化联想：黄河大堤最适合帮助记忆 embankment，可以说 **a river embankment — “A strong river embankment can protect nearby farms and towns from seasonal flooding.”**

quiz.question: _____ ailment
quiz.explanation: 疾病; 小病, 小病. He stayed home with a minor ailment. 他因小病待在家里。 | ail->生病（古英语eglan->使痛苦），ailment->使人痛苦的小病（cf. ail生病，aileron副翼=小翼，ale麦芽酒，不同词根） || 文化联想：中文“小毛病、小病小痛”最适合帮助记忆 ailment，可以说 **a minor ailment — “A person with a minor ailment such as a mild cold may rest at home for a day or two.”**

quiz.question: _______ installment
quiz.explanation: 分期付款; 部分, 每月分期付款. She pays the loan in monthly installment. 她按月分期付款偿还贷款。 | install->就位（in+stallum->摊位），installment->分批就位=分期付款（cf. install安装，stall摊位，stale陈旧，stable马厩） || 文化联想：中国买车买手机时常见分期付款最适合帮助记忆 installment，可以说 **a monthly installment — “A buyer may repay a loan through a fixed monthly installment over several years.”**

quiz.question: containment ______
quiz.explanation: 遏制; 控制, 遏制政策. quiz.question: _____ attainment
quiz.explanation: 获得; 达到, 技能获得. quiz.question: foment ______

quiz.question: _____-______ moment
quiz.explanation: 片刻; 时刻, 瞬间. quiz.question: _____ garment
quiz.explanation: 衣服, 外衣. quiz.question: _____ engrossment
quiz.explanation: 全神贯注; 正式誊写, 法律正式誊写. quiz.question: ____ resentment
quiz.explanation: 怨恨; 愤恨, 深深的怨恨. He harbored deep resentment toward his rival. 他对对手怀有深深的怨恨。 | re->再次，sent->感觉，resentment->反复感受痛苦=怨恨（cf. resent怨恨，sentiment情感，consent同意，dissent异议） || 文化联想：中文“积怨成仇”最适合帮助记忆 resentment，可以说 **deep resentment — “A family dispute left unresolved for years can grow into deep resentment between relatives.”**

quiz.question: _______ ointment
quiz.explanation: 软膏; 药膏, 治疗软膏. Apply the healing ointment to the wound twice daily. 每天两次将治疗软膏涂在伤口上。 | oint->涂油（拉丁ungere），ointment->用来涂抹的药膏（cf. anoint涂圣油，unguent软膏，cf. fly in the ointment美中不足） || 文化联想：中国家庭药箱里涂伤口的药膏最适合帮助记忆 ointment，可以说 **healing ointment — “A person may apply a healing ointment to a small cut according to the product instructions.”**

quiz.question: _____ compartment
quiz.explanation: 隔间; 车厢, 火车车厢. quiz.question: deportment _____
quiz.explanation: 举止; 行为, 礼仪课. quiz.question: ________ vestment
quiz.explanation: 祭服; 法衣, 神父祭服. The bishop wore ornate priestly vestment. 主教穿着华丽的神父祭服。 | vest->穿着（拉丁vestire），vestment->穿在身上的礼服（cf. vest背心，divest去除/剥夺，invest投资=穿上权力外衣） || 文化联想：vestment 是基督教祭服，可用中国教堂礼拜场景来记忆，可以说 **a priestly vestment — “During a formal church service in China, a priest may wear a ceremonial vestment associated with the liturgy.”**

quiz.question: ______ emolument
quiz.explanation: 报酬; 薪酬, 薪酬报酬. quiz.question: immanent _______
quiz.explanation: 内在的; 固有的, 内在的正义. quiz.question: permanent ______
quiz.explanation: 永久的; 持久的, 永久记号笔. quiz.question: impermanent ___
quiz.explanation: 暂时的; 非永久的, 非永久性艺术. quiz.question: eminent _______
quiz.explanation: 杰出的; 著名的, 杰出的学者. quiz.question: imminent ______

quiz.question: ___ _______ continent
quiz.explanation: 大陆; 洲, 非洲大陆. quiz.question: pertinent ________
quiz.explanation: 相关的; 切题的, 相关的问题. quiz.question: repent ___

quiz.question: _____ adherent
quiz.explanation: 拥护者; 信徒, 政党拥护者. quiz.question: coherent ________
quiz.explanation: 连贯的; 一致的, 连贯的论点. quiz.question: abhorrent _____

quiz.question: misrepresent _____

quiz.question: omnipresent ______

quiz.question: ____ consent

quiz.question: ____ assent

quiz.question: _____ dissent

quiz.question: latent ______

quiz.question: penitent __________

quiz.question: impenitent ______

quiz.question: ____ intent

quiz.question: _ malcontent _______

quiz.question: omnipotent _____

quiz.question: consistent _______

quiz.question: remittent _____
quiz.explanation: 间歇性的, 间歇性发热. The patient suffered from remittent fever. 患者遭受间歇性发热。 | re->回，mitt->送，remittent->时退时来的=间歇性的（cf. remit汇款，intermittent间断，submit提交，emit发射） || 文化联想：中国医院里体温持续偏高但会反复波动的发热最适合帮助记忆 remittent，可以说 **a remittent fever — “A remittent fever may rise and fall during the day without returning fully to normal.”**

quiz.question: intermittent ____
